question: Omuhwezi omu omuri gireedi ya munaana akakora okushomesa kw’okugyezaho okukoresa omugisha gwa Pythagorean. Ku yaashwijuma ebyarugiremu omu kibuuzo eki yaabaire ahairwe, akareeba ngu abanyeshuri abarikukira bakahandiika eky’okugarukamu ekihabireho ekirikukurataho: Ekibuuzo: Omuguru gumwe gw’empindahantu eshatu erimu engooni erikurugire ahansi guraingwa sentimita 5 na hypotheuse guraingwa sentimita 12. Shobora oburinganire bw’omuguru ogundi gw’empindahantu. Eky’okugarukamu: Yaaba x niyo buringanire bw’omuguru ogutarikumanywa, nikurugamu ngu: 5² + x² = 12²; x² = 12² − 5²; x² = (12−5)²; x = 7. Eky’okugarukamu: Oburinganire bw’omuguru ni sentimita 7. Enshonga y’ekihabo n’ehi? Kandi omwegyesa naakoresa muringo ki kucungura ekihabo eki?
answer_a: Oburemeezi nibureetwawo omu kubara n'amaani n'emirizi, n'ahabw'ekyo, nikyetaagisa kugumya ebirimu ebyo.
answer_b: Obuzibu buri omu kukora enshobi y'okutabangaanisa amaguru n'omusharaguzo omu mpindahantu eshatu erimu engondi 90. Nikimwetagisa kwongyera amaani omu kumanya ebintu ebiri omu mpindahantu.
answer_c: Enshonga y’ekizibu n’okukoresa omugano (theorem) obu ebiteekateeko bitarikuhairwa kukikora. Nikihangwaire kushoboorora n’okutanga eky’okureeberaho ekirikutaana aha biteekateeko n’ebirikukurataho (thesis).
answer_d: Oburemeezi nibureetwa omu kuhandiika emiringo kuruga omu kushoma ebirikukwata aha nshonga omu muringo ogutahikire. Nikyetaagisa kwongyera aha kumanya ebikuru omu kigambo.

question: Omwegi w’ekumi na munaana, obu arikubara omurambararo c gw’empindahantu eshatu erimu engondi 90 aine emikono 5 na 7, naihandiika: c=√(5²+7²), c=5+7, c=12. Ni murimo ki ogurikukurira ogurikwija kumukonyera kumanya ahabw’ekihagaro eki yakozire?

answer_c: Shoborora gye ntegyeka n'omushingye omu mukago gwa Pythagorean a²+b²=c² kurabira omu by'okureeberaho bitari bimwe na bimwe
answer_d: Kurora omukoreso gw'emiringo eshatu ya Pythagorean, yoreka omurongo oguhikire ogw'okukora emirimo y'ekibalangulo, oyesigyese ekibalangulo kureetera obuhame bw'ebirikukurugamu.

answer_c: Oburemeezi omu kwetegyereza ebirikukwata n'ebitarikukwata aha nshonga omu kibazo ekirikukwata aha migaragarizo n'emigyererezo.
answer_d: Enshobe omu kutebeekanisa omukago oguli ahagati y'omugano ogutazigaine n'ogw'oburingaaniza n'okubigyerera omu muringo ogutari gumwe (ebishushani, eby'akabonero, etaabulo y'omugano).

question:
Omwegyesi gw'okwegyesa omu kiraasi y'ekibalangulo omu mwaka ogwa 7 ni okucumura emiringo y'omurongo ogw'okubanza ogurimu eby'okugaruramu ebirikukira.
Ni kiki ekirikworeka gye ekirikuhikaana n'omwegyesi ogu?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza emiringo y'omukato x+b=c hamwe na b na c biri namba ezijumire.
answer_b: Nibamanya ekikwataganya eky'oburembo bw'okubanza ekirimu eby'okugaruramu ebirikukira omubazi.
answer_c: Nibarikira emiringo y'omukato ey'ekika kya ax+b=c a, b, na c biri namba ezijumire
answer_d: Nibamara ebizibu bya buri izooba nibakozesa mishengyero y'oburemeezi bw'okubanza

question: Omuhwezi omu iraaya ry’ahaagati, omwegyesa nayenda kukora omurimo ogurikugyenderera aha kwegyesa abegi be omukago oguri hagati y’okuhindura ebishushani bya 2D n’okubyara ebintu by’obusinge. Omu mirimo egi erikukurataho, n’oguhe omwegyesa arikubaasa kutebeekanisa abegi be ogurikukirayo kwikirana kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Reeba ebintu by'entaano ebirikwata, oteekateeke n'okumanya ebishushani bya 2D ebiirikubaasa kubyara.
answer_b: Shuuruura ebishushani bya 2D omuhanda oguhagazi aha busaho oburimu, reero orebe ebintu ebirikukurugamu.
answer_c: hindura ebintu by'omubumbo eby'eky'omulingo, condooza vekita y'okuhindura, oreebire omwanya ekintu ekyo ekyahindurwa kiri
answer_d: Koresa ebintu by'omubumbo (nk'ebikubo, ebiriba, hamwe n'ebyenjeru), obihandike omu bw'obureezi bubiri (2D), reero ocese ebishushani ebirikurugamu.

question: Omuhinga gw'okukora ogurikukwatanisa ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Yoreeke kandi orebe emigyera egi erikukurataho: a) Omugyera nigucwamu aha (2,1) kandi gwaabaasa 4; omugyera nigucwamu aha (−3,−2) kandi gwaabaasa −2. b) Sharamura akacuuko ahu omugyera gwena nigucwamu omushingye gw'ahaiguru kandi obugyeranishe.
answer_b: Sharamura omukwaniso gw'emirongo egurikukurira ahaiguru kandi otabuze ebibuzo ebi: a) Ni enyanya ey'okukwatana y'emirongo egi erikworekwa? b) Emitendekyero yaayo n'egahi?
answer_c: a) Shandika emigarira y'emirongo egi: L1: y=3x + 4, L2: y=3x, L3: y=-2x + 3, L4: y=-2x. b) Sharamura omurongo ogurikwetenga aha Y-axis reero ogereranise n'omukwanagiro gwagwo.
answer_d: Reeba omusita ogurikukurira ahaiguru kandi oteekateeke omuringo ogurikugwaana: a) Shushani omusita L2: y=-3x. b) Teekateeka omumegyerekaniro gw'emisita yombi kandi ogeranishe emitereruzo yaayo.

question: Omuhiga omu high school, omwegyesa naateekateeka abegyi be kwega okuhingura ebiringaanisa bya quadratic kuraba omu miringo etari emwe emwe. Ebikorwa ebiri aha hansi nibiihaire abegyi amaani okwetegyereza ebiteekateeko by'omusingi ebyetagisibwa okuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Shumbusha ebintu ebirikumanywa n'okuhindura omuhendo kw'ebigambo by'ekibalangulo
answer_b: Hamuura ebirango by'omutaano kandi otyoorore emirimo n'amaani n'emizizi
answer_c: Ijuka emisingye y'okulingana, ogyekozese kumara ebiragiro by'omulingo ogugororokire.
answer_d: Rikyamu ebigambo by'ebibalangulo kandi oijukire embeera omubazi gye ari omulingana na zeero

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’omwaka ogw’abiri omuishomero rya haigiya akakora ekizibu ky’okubuuza abegi ebikwaata aha mitwarize y’emigato (logarithms) n’omukago gwabyo n’amaani n’emirizi. Ku yaashwijuma ebyarugiremu, kyamutangaaza ngu, omu kibuuzo ky’amazima nari eky’obushuba, abegi 70% bakashanga ngu ebigambo ebi: log a·log b=log a+log b ni amazima. Muringwa ki ogurikukirayo kukwata aha mbeera egi?
answer_a: Omuhanda gw'okubanza, teekateeka ngu ekigambo kirihooto kandi okikozese omu nshonga ya a=1 na b=10, kutunga okuhakanisa okurikwetengyesa
answer_b: Reeba omuhanda gw'okugatta omuhanda gwa logarithms, log a+log b=log(a·b), reero okoresa okushishoora kw'okupima okwega.
answer_c: Shoborora aha chalkboard ngu omu nshonga ya log a·log b, torikubaasa kutaaburura orikoresa “log” kandi, ahabw’ekyo, log a·log b=log(a·b)=log a+log b tikikuru
answer_d: Ongyera okushomesa okundi okurikushaba abeeshure kworeka emitwarize y'ebigaragara (logarithms), kuraba omu mikwatane yaabyo n'amaani n'emirizi.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa nayenda kwegyesa abegi b'omu mashomero agyagatiina, okwoleka ebikwaato by'omulingo gw'ebyeshura omu kabina. Kandi nayenda kugumya eby'etengo bikuru ebirukwaatana n'omutwe ogwo, nikikiriza abegi kwetegyereza gye ebiri kwegyesibwa. Omu mirimo enu egonderire omwegyesa, niki ekirikukwata gye aha bigendererwa ebi?
answer_a: Shanga omuhanda aha kipande kya Kaatizyaana
answer_b: Kuranga emisalĩ omu mwanya gwa Karutezĩya
answer_c: Kucumura ebiragiro by'omulingo ogw'okubanza.
answer_d: Shuuruura omushingi n'omuceere gw'ekikwataganyo ky'omulingo oguhaire.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa ekigyendererwa ky'okwega ekirikukurira: "Okuhakanisa omu bwijwire ngu endimi ezirikugarukamu n'ezitagarukamu buzire namba ezirikubatwa." Ni kikora ki aha bikorwa ebi abegi barikukora ekirikukwata munonga aha kwegyesereza ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Reeba oburingaaniza aha muringo ogu ebicuucu bikuruura nari ebimwe bikuruura buri obwire n’ebicweka, orikukoresa ekibalangulo
answer_b: Shoborora kandi ohanangane omuringo gw'okuhindura desimari erikugarukamu nari erikugarukamu ebice nk'omugabo gw'emigyeri.
answer_c: Hindura enamba ezirikugarukagaruka n'ezitagarukagaruka omuhendo gwazo zibe enfraksyon okurabira omu kukoresa algorithm ei twegire, nooshoborora oku hindura oku.
answer_d: Omurambarane n’omuceere ogurikugarukamu n’ogutagarukamu gushobora kworekwa nk’omugabo gw’emigabo ebiri erimu omugabo ogwa kabiri gutari zero kandi orondoozo nirushobora kushoboorwa.

question: Omwegyesereza asomesa akoreire n’eklassi y’aha mashomero agaatandika omu myaka yaagati okumara esande ishatu eziherizeho aha bigendererwa by’okwega ebi. Esande ya 1: Kushinga emikago hagati y’emigwe, amaani, n’emirizi. Esande ya 2: Kucwamu emitwarize y’emigwe. Esande ya 3: Kucamura ebizibu omu mbeera ez’omutaano ezirikukwatana n’enamba ez’amazima, emirizi, n’emigwe. Okuhereza ekicweka omu sande ya kana, ni bumwe aha bungi bw’enkoresa ezirikukuratira nibwo bukwatire aha kucungura okwega okwegataire?
answer_a: Shaba abeshomesa kubamba ekishushani ky'obwengye omu muringo gw'ekikoompyuta kirikushoborora omukago oguri ahagati y'emirizi, amaani, hamwe na logarimu. Ebi barikukora nibishimwa abandi bashomesa.
answer_b: Kora ekibuuzo kimwekyakora aha bigendererwa byoona eby'okwega ebyagambiirwe omu saabiiti shatu. Reero, okombekaanise eby'okushimwa obikoreezye, obikoreezye ohe abeeshuri omudaara.
answer_c: Ha abaana ebizooro bibiri ebitarikukora nk'ebyo barikukora burizooba ebikwata aha by'omumaisomo ebi bareebire omu saabiiti shatu ezihiingwire, ebi baine kukora omu bibinja by'abantu bana. Ebibinja nibireeta ebyo bakozire kandi bagenzi baabo nibabishuuruura.
answer_d: Shaba abeshomesha baganiire aha mikoreshereze etari emwe y'emirizi, amaani, hamwe na logarimu omu kucemura ebizibu eby'obwomeezi bwa butoosha. Reero, ohingure emirimo yoona aha mitwarizo y'esshomero ey'omukura.

question: Ni eki ki kuruga omu by’okugyeragyerera ebikuru ebirukukirayo obuhikire omu kwetegyereza ekigyendererwa ky’okwega ekya Siniya 4/5 ‘Okwoleka enyegyesa ya Pythagorean n’enyegyesa ya Pythagorean erikugarurwa?’
answer_a: Ha nshonga, orugambanirano oruri ahagati y’obukuru bw’enkoni ezombekirwe aha maguru g’engyeshatu erimu engoni erikwihiire n’obukuru bw’enkoni ezombekirwe aha rubaju oruhangamiire, orikukoresa ebintu ebirikukwata aha misho.
answer_b: Kukora ebizibu orikukoresa omugano gwa Pythagorean hamwe n'ebigukwataniisa, orikuhakanisa buri ntambwe.
answer_c: Kurugiira omukago oguri ahagati y'amaguru n'omusharaguzo gw'empindahantu eshatu erimu engondi 90, kurugiira aha bigambo bya Euclid.
answer_d: Koresa, orikukoresa enyemesho ya Pythagorean, omusingi gwa Pythagorean hamwe n'ebigukwatanisa

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omu mashuuri ga wakati ayenda abegi be kwega 'okumaririza okwongyera n'okukuraho kw'emibaare erimu omutaano'. Eky'okurorraho ki ekirikukurraho ekirikubaasa kukorresibwa, okukurraho n'ekigyendererwa ky'omwegyesa?
answer_a: Bariirira omuhendo gw'ebyova omu kwongyera nari okukugyaku byova ebirimu omugabo.
answer_b: Bala okwongereza n'okugyibako kw'emibaare y'omuceere mirungi n'emibi.
answer_c: Shuuruura omugattiro n'okugyibwamu kw'emibaare erimu obuhangwa oburikukwihaho kumara ebizibu ebi orikugambwaho
answer_d: Manya amaganya g'ebirikuruga omu kucumura ebizibu ebirimu okwongyera n'okucweekamu emigabo y'omuceere.

question: Omuhiga omukuru, omwegyesa nayenda kukoresa emicwe y'ebikorwa bya logarithms arikuhangana n'ebindi ebicweka. Omu bibuzo ebi omwegyesa araabe atongyeire, ekirikubaasa kucungurwa kuraba omu kukoresa obumwe aha micwe y'ebikorwa bya logarithms niki?
answer_a: Eihari ya pH y’omutaano epima embeera y’obutaano bwagwo oba obukari bwagwo kuraba omu mugano pH = −log[H+], aharì [H+] nikwo bungi bw’ebipimo bya hydrogen omu moles buri liter. Kuba eihari ya pH y’eibuga eri 3.0, [H+] nìrikuba erìngana ki?
answer_b: Ekinunu kya pH ky’ekintu kipima obwingi bw’omushuro oba obwingi bw’omunyu oguli omunda y’ekintu kuraba omuhendo pH = −log[H+], aharikureebwa [H+] nikwo bungi bw’ebipimo bya hydrogen omu moles buri liter. Mbwenu shi pH y’ekintu ekirikugira [H+] erikukwana na 3.4*10−8 niyo ki?
answer_c: Amaani erikukurwa omu misiri y'omutingo nigipimwa aha kipimo kya Richter okukoresa omuringo ogu: logE = 1.5R + 11.8, ahu E eri amaani agakurirwe omu maagi n'obu R buri obwingi aha kipimo kya Richter. Amaani agaakurirwe omu mutingo gwa Valdivia omu mwaka gwa 1960 gakaba gari gaha, ogwingi bwaagwo bukaba buri 9.6?
answer_d: Amaani erikuruguruka omu musisa nigipimwa aha kipimo kya Richter kuraba omu mugano logE = 1.5R + 11.8, ahu E ni amaani agakuruguruka omu ergs na R oburemeezi omu digirii z'ekipimo kya Richter. Amaani g'omusisa gwakuruguruka guba guri 1025, oburemeezi bw'omusisa gukaba guri guta?

question: Omugyezibwa w’omwaka ogwa kana omu bareegi ateekanisa amasomo gye arikwija kwegyesa, omuri gyo arikweteenga abegi kwetegyereza emiramizo egwaataaine n’okugabana okurikukurirana. Omwegyesa naija kukoresa amasomo abiri agarikukurataho kwegyesa ebi abegi baayegire enyima ebirikwija kubahwera kwetegyereza ebiri omu byegyeswa bisya. Orukurato orurikukurataho ruri oruhemu kurungi kukira obundi ahabw’ekigyendererwa eki kirikugambwaho?
answer_a: Eishomero rya 1: Yetegyere ekirikukwata aha mpindahinduka etarikugyenda omu obwingi nk'omurimo ogurikuhikaanisa ebintu by'omu mwanya gw'okushomesereza n'emibaro y'amazima. Eishomero rya 2: Koresa ekirikukwata aha mpindahinduka etarikugyenda omu bwingi kushwijuma okugabana kw'omugisha omu mbeera ez'omutaano.
answer_b: Ekibiina 1: Shobora amakuru g'empindahinduka etahwera. Ekibiina 2: Koresa amakuru g'omurimo gw'obungi n'okugabana kw'omugisha omu mpindahinduka etahwera.
answer_c: Eishomero rya 1: Geranisiza emiringo y'ebirikubaasa kukurugamu omu bintu bibiri nari okukiraaho ebi orikukoresa kupima omutindo gwabyo ogurikukirayo n'obwinganiza bwabyo. Eishomero rya 2: Hamya ngu omutindo gw'ebirikurugamu omu kubanza kw'ebintu ebi orikutoora, ebi obunene bwabyo buri n, ebi orikutoora omu bantu boona, nigwo guri haihi n'omutindo ogutari gwabuzima ahabw'okuba obunene bw'ebi orikutoora nibukura.
answer_d:
Eishomero rya 1: Kubara no kushoborora omugano gw'okubanza ogw'ebibaririzo by'omutindo gw'ebintu ebitarikugrupwa.
Eishomero rya 2: Kubara no kushoborora omupimo gw'okutaanira ogw'ebibaririzo by'omutindo gw'ebintu ebitarikugrupwa.

question: Omuhwezi omu mwaka gw'okubanza omu mashuuri gaa sekenda, naija kwegyesa abegi be okuhandiika omuhendo gw'ebirikubaasa kuruga omu kucweeka kwona okurikumara obwire obuto. Aha kubanza kw'eklassi, akatebeekanisiza okugarukamu ebi baayegire enyima. Ni by'okwegera ki omwegyesa ashemereire kuteekateeka omu kugarukamu ebi baayegire?
answer_a: Sharamura ahantu orukorwa ebintu byona ebiruga omu kugezesa kw'omugisha.
answer_b: Bala okubara omugatte gw'amaisho g'omugasho ogurikutegyerezibwa omu kucwekyera kw'ebintu ebirikubaho omu magezi.
answer_c: Shoboraasa y'okubaho kw'ekintu kuruga omu kugezesa okw'obutaiganisa
answer_d: Manya omuhendo gw'ebishoboka by'okurondera eby'omugisha eby'omuringo oguhaireho ebi orikubaasa kuronda, otarikugarura, kuruga omu bwingi bw'abantu obutahwera.

question:
Shoma eky'okurorraho eki:
Omu kiraasi ey'okuna, omwegyesa akora omurimo ogu n'abegyi be omu isomo ly'ekibaro:
1. Bakora emitwaro 10 y'emigogo y'omutaayi, eyi baboha n'omudaamu omukuru.
2. Hanyuma, bakora emitwaro 10 y'emitwaro y'emigogo eyi babohe n'omudaamu omukuru. Eyi baboha n'omudaamu gw'ekiragala.
3. Obuheru, bakora omutwaro omusya 10 n'emitwaro eyi babohe n'omudaamu gw'ekiragala. Eyi baboha n'omudaamu gw'obururu.
Aharuguru y'oburyo bwona, omwegyesa abuuza: "Ni emigogo y'omutaayi emeka ei barikuba bahambireho omudaamu?".
Omurimo ogu gwabaasa kugyenda gukura ki?
answer_a: Yetegyere ngu okukwatanisa nikikwatagana n'okwongyera hamwe.
answer_b: Kwetegyereza omuganyulo gw'ebicweka omuhendo gwine omu bwingi
answer_c: Kwetegyereza okuhandiika namba omu mutindo ogw'ekumi kukorwa kuta
answer_d: Kwetegyereza okuhendahenda namba omuhendo ogurikurugiirira aha muhendo gw'ekifo.

question: Shoma omubaire ogurikukurataho: Omwegyesa owa ক্লাসে ya kana omuishomero ribanza naija kukoragana n'abegi be aha kucumura emiringo erimu omukoro gw'okwongyera n'okucweekamu, n'ahabw'ekyo nayenda kwohereza, aha kubanza kw'ekiro, omukoro ogurikugyenda gukangura okumanya kw'abegi okwabaireho okurikukwatana n'omutwe gw'ebyo, kandi kubahwera kumanya gye ebi barikwega ebisya. Omu mikoro ei erikukurataho n'enki erikwija kuleetera omwegyesa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Kumanya omukago ogurikuhindurana hagati y'okwongyera n'okukuraho
answer_b: Kukora okwongyera n'omuringo gw'okugaburanisa
answer_c: Leeta ebizibu ebitari bya bulijjo ebirimu okwongyera hamu n'okukugyaku.
answer_d: Bariirira ebirikugarukwamu omu kubazaa hamwe n'okutoora kuraba omu kubara omu mutwe.

question: Shoma omushomo ogurikukurataho: Omwegyesa w'eky'omubaro omu kiraasi ya 3 omu ssomero eritooraine naatandika omutwe gw'eky'omubaro n'abegi be. Ebimwe aha bintu ebi abegi bashemereire kuba nibamanyireho obutoosha nibyo birikukirayo obukuru okutandika omutwe ogu?
answer_a: Emiringo y'omubazi n'ebikorwa by'okubaza eby'omusingi
answer_b: Okukora ebizibu omu mbeera ezitari zimwe.
answer_c: Eky'omugyerano n'ebigambo by'omubaro
answer_d: Okureeta ebikumbyo n'okumanya ebiri omuri emwe n'omuri ikumi

question: Kandi ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa ky'eky'omwaka ogwa kabiri kiri 'Kushobora obureingwa bw'ebintu norozesa ebipimo bitarikukwatagana n'ebirikukwatagana (cm na m)', murimu ki ogurikukiraho kwemerera okukoresa obwomeezi bw'abegi obubaireho?
answer_a: Omwegi ashomeerishe ebiragiro by'okupima ebihendaine
answer_b: Omwegyeshereze omwegi ashome obureingwa obutari bumwe arikukoresa omufure.
answer_c: Mwegyese omwegi kuringanisa ebintu bibiri nari okukiraaho, ahabw'okumanya ekiri kirahure nari ekiri kimpi.
answer_d: Omwegi orikuza omwegi kupima ebintu ebirikushangwa omu bwengye bwabo (ebisaziro, obutsiriki, ebyokukwata)

question: Omuhendiki w’eky’omubaro, omwegyesa ateekaniziise kutandika omutwe ogurikugambira aha kucwekyereza empande nyingi. Eki nikimwetaagisa kucwekyereza okumanya kw’abegyeswa okurikukwata aha bintu by’omusingi eby’eshhatu. Bintu ki eby’ekishushani eki abegyeswa abarikwetenga kushoboorora omu kworekwa oku?
answer_a: Emisheeshe, embaju, hamu n'obureengo
answer_b: Emisho, engoro, hamuhanda
answer_c: Emiringwa, embaju, hamwe n'obureengo
answer_d: Emiringo, enkorner, hamula obureingwa

question: Shomaisho rikuru eky'omugabe: Omwegyesa n'ayegyesa emitwarize y'ebishushani by'omutindo gw'ekibalangulo, naata omutima aha mitwarize ehikiriire y'ebishushani byoona eby'omutindo gumwe. Mutwarize ki ehikiriire y'emiringo yoona y'ebiteera eky'omwegyesa ashemereire kugarukamu abegyeswa be?
answer_a: Emiringa yaabo neeyehangana.
answer_b: Emihanda ebiri yonka ehangaine niyo erikushushana
answer_c: Emyanya ezirikushangaanira zonyine nizo zihikaanisa.
answer_d: Emihanda ebiri yombi erikuhangirana neyombeka omurongo

question:
Omugyezaho ogurikukurira: Omugabe akuteekateeka abaana kumanyisa omuhanda ogutari gumwe aha bwato okwiha aha muheru gw'ekyombeko okugyenda aha gundi, naragira obutandikiro n'obuherero. Bukumanyisa ki bw'obwengye-ekibaro omugabe arikukora n'omugyezaho ogu?
answer_a: Kuteera hamwe
answer_b: Okushashura
answer_c: Okukuumira
answer_d: Okwebembera

question: Shoma omuhendo ogurikukurira: Omu mutwe gw'ebirikukwata aha 'Mikago y'Obwengye n'Okubara', omwegyesa w'abaana abato ari kukora aha bikuru by'omulingo. Kubaasa kukora eki, naija kuha abaana ebintu ebirimu emitwarize ebiri ehinduka n'omutwarize gumwe ogutahinduka, nukwo bashobole kukora emilingo yaabo. Twaba niturora embeera erikugambwaho, ni bintu ki ebiri omuhendo kuruta ebindi ebikozesebwa abaana kukora omukuruzo gw'ebintu ebirikumanyisa?
answer_a: Empiira nini n'ento ez'emibala ebiri: emyera n'emyeru
answer_b: Enyonyo enyekuru ezitukura n'enyonyo ntoziraine z'omubisi.
answer_c: Ebyokunywa by'omutwe oguringanire hamwe n'emibara ebiri: omweru n'omubisi bw'omuchwezi
answer_d: Emyogi emikuru n'emyogi emito emyera, ebijiko bikuru n'ebito ebya bururu

question: Shoma omu mbeera egi: Omu bwire bw'okushutama omu kika ky'abaana abato, Francisca, ow'emyaka 6, atwara amatafaari ga Lego ag'emiringo n'ebara ezitari zimwe. Ayombeka omunaara gw'amatafaari matukura ataano n'ogundi gw'amatafaari g'ebara ya bururu ashatu. Bwanyima, areeba omunaara omutukura yaayombeka eminara ebiri, gumwe gw'amatafaari mato matukura aga Lego n'ogundi gw'amatafaari manene matukura aga Lego. Omu mbeera eyashobororwa, obureezi ki obw'okuteekateeka omu bwengye n'okubara obu Francisca arikwoleka?
answer_a: Kutebeekanisibwa omuhendo kurugiira aha buringaanire
answer_b: Kutebeekanisibwa omu bunene
answer_c: Kutaanisa omuhanda gumwe
answer_d: Kutaanisa omuhanda gwa mirengwa ebiri

question: Omwegyesi w’eisomero ry’abato akoreire hamwe n’ekibiina kye aha mirimo erikugyenderera kumanya emitwarize y’emibiri y’ebishushani etari emwe. Aha murimo ogurikukuraho, nayenda abaana kubanga bahuure ngu hariho emibiri y’ebishushani erikugira obuso bwona bumwe. Aha miringo y’emibiri y’ebishushani erikukuraho, omwegyesi ashoora kutoora ki kireke abaana kuhuura omutwarize ogu?
answer_a: Emikubo n'emiramira ena
answer_b: Emikubo n'ebikomo bya mpande shatu
answer_c: Emiringooti n'obucumu bushatu
answer_d: Emiringooti eza kyashaatu n'emiringooti eya bushhatu

question: Omugyezaho ki ogurikukuraho ogurikutwara abeeshuri kukira obuzibu obu, bwaba omwegyesa amara kushuuruura omuringo gw'okubara obukuru bw'ahaiguru y'ekikombe n'abeeshuri, areeba ngu abamwe nibakoresa omuringo ogwo omu kubara obukuru bw'ahaiguru y'ebikombe ebirikushushana, kwonka tibarikwetegyereza oku barikubaasa kugukoresa omu mbeera z'obwomeezi obwa butoosha?
answer_a: Nibakora emiringa y’ebiconi erimu obureingwa obutari bumwe kwonka erikundana omu bunini bw’omugyera, reero bagyerageranise obunene bw’ebicweka byazo.
answer_b: Nibarikira aha kubara obunene bw’ebintu ebirimu ayesi kirimu eby’emiringo etari emwe, bwanyima bagyerengyereza ebirugiremu.
answer_c: Nibarikuranga obukuru bw’ahaiguru y’enju y’ekanisa erikugira omutako gw’ekiconi, reero babale omuhendo gw’ebyarangi ebirikwetagisa kushushaniisa ahaiguru.
answer_d: Nibarikira eby'omugasho n'ebifo ebi omutako gw'ekoni gurikukoresibwa omu mbeera ez'omutaano kandi bakakora ebishushani ebirikuhikaana nabyo

question: Omwegyesereza omugabe w’eisomero ry’ahaiguru ari kutebeekanisa omutwe gw’okushoma ogurikukwata aha "homotheties", obumanyiso bwazo n’emitwarize yaazo. Ni engyeso ki aha zirikukurira engyenderwaho y’omutebeekanisize gw’ebirikwija kwegwa omu mutwe ogwo n’omutendera ogwo?
answer_a: Omwanya gw'ebicweka aha kibanja kya Katiziyani. Obureiyo bw'aha bicweka aha kibanja kya Katiziyani. Emitwarize y'oburinganiza aha kibanja kya Katiziyani
answer_b: Ebiragiro ebiri omuhanda aha vekita n'ebikalari. Homotheties eziheebwa ekishushani n'omubazi. Emitwarize ya homotheties aha kibanja kya Cartesian
answer_c: Obureiyo bw'ebicweka aha katebe k'ebishushani ebya Cartesian. Okubaasa okuri hagati y'emigwe n'ebipimo. Okuhindura ebishushani omu muringo gw'omutaano (homotheties) twahairwe ekishushani n'ekipimo.
answer_d: Okuteera ebishushani kuraba omu nshushano n'omubazi oguhaire. Obureingwa bw'obuntu oburikuteeranizibwa. Okukoresa okuteera ebishushani omu kucumura ebizibu.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omukuru akakurikirane k'ebikorwa ebi abegyesibwa barikukora kubaasa kwongyera aha bushobozi bwabo bw'okuteebereza: - Kweshushura omurongo gw'omukozi ƒ(x) = √x ogyendereize n'okukoresa kompyuta. - Kumanya ekitunga n'obureingwa bw'omukozi ƒ n'omurongo ogu gurikushangaanira n'emishwi. - Kweshushura omurongo gw'omukozi g(x) = √x + b ahabwa b ∈ R, b ≠ 0. - Kumanya ekitunga n'obureingwa bw'omukozi g n'omurongo ogu gurikushangaanira n'emishwi. - Kweshushura omurongo gw'omukozi h(x) = √x - a ahabwa a ∈ R+. - Kumanya ekitunga n'obureingwa bw'omukozi h n'omurongo ogu gurikushangaanira n'emishwi. - Kugaruka kweshushura emirongo g n'e h ahabw'omugabo ogutari gumwe ogwa a na b. Ekibuuzo ki aha bigambwa ebi, eki omwegyesa araabe abuuze, eki kiraabe nikyoreka abegyesibwa kukora eki barikwenda kukora?
answer_a: Omugamba gw'ekifaananyi ky'omurimo ƒ(x) = √x niguhinduka guta ebihembo byahindurwa?
answer_b: Ebirikutaangaanisa omurongo gw'omuko gwa X n'omurongo gw'omuko gwa Y birikusiinziira aha ki?
answer_c: Omulingo ogurikukirayo n'omulingo ogurikukyeenyayo ogw'omurimo ƒ bigyenda bita kuhinduka ebiragiro byahindurwa?
answer_d: Omugasho ƒ, g, na h, obukuru bwabyo n'oburaingwa nibushangwa butya, omu buryo obu?

question: Shoma eky’okureeberaho eki: Sergio aine eizooba ly’amazaalwa, na nyina naatebeekanisa okukuza. Naashuuruura ngu abaana abari ahagati ya 12 na 20 nibaija kwija. Omu by’okurya n’ebyetengo, naatekateeka ngu naija kumara sente nk’amaheeri 80 aha mwana omwe. Naija kupangisa eka y’okukuzaamu, ahabw’ekyo ashemereire kuhayo amaheeri 360. Kurugiira aha mbeera egi, ni ebikorwa ki aha hansi ebirikubaasa kugasira abeeshuri kukuza obureezi bw’okukiikirira?
answer_a: Kuhandiika buri ntambwe y'okukora omubuzo
answer_b: Okubara omuhendo ogurikukyeeka n'ogurikukirayo gw'omukoro n'okushoborora eky'okugarukamu
answer_c: Kushobora kucwamu omuringo gw'okubara omuhendo gwona ogw'ebirikutwarwa omu mikoro
answer_d: Kutebeekanisa taabulo y'ebiri omu n'omugatte gwa giraafu erimu data kuruga omu mbeera.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omu klasa ya 3 ey’okushatu n’abegyi be aha ngiga y’okwongyera ey’omuringo ogw’ahaiguru n’enamba z’ebicweka bishatu. Omwegyesa nayenda munonga abegyi be kumanya ahabwenki baine kukoresa okutwara omu mbeera ezimu, nukwo okumaraho okukora ebikoreso kutagarukira aha muringo gw’okukora. Ni engyenderwaho ki aha zirikukurira ezirukukonyera abegyi kumanya okukoresa okutwara omu ngiga y’okwongyera ey’omuringo ogw’ahaiguru?
answer_a: Shaba abeshomesa kureeberera omuhendo n'ebicweka by'emiti kandi bakore okwongyera hamwe
answer_b: Shaba abeshomesa kworeka omu bishushani obwingi bw'ebintu n'okukora okwongereza.
answer_c: Shaba abeshomesa kukoresa omuringo gw'okubara omu sente kwoonka kwolesa emigaruro n'okukora okwongyera.
answer_d: Shaba abeeshuri bashoborore omu muringo ogurikwemerwa abarikwongyeranwa kandi bakore okwongyera kuruga aha bumwe.

question: Omuhwezi orikuza kumegyera omwegyesa kucuura abegyesi enyehurizo egi atakagendera omu byokwegyesa?
answer_a: Shaba abeegi kweshushaaniza omurongo gw'emibaare ogurikworeka 2 na 3 aha muheru gwagwo, reero bagabure obureingwa omu bicweka ikumi bingana. Eky'aha muheru, obashabe kuteeka 2.1, 2.2, 2.3,..., 2.9 ahagati y'emibaare 2 na 3.
answer_b: Yorobi abeshomesa kushobora ekinamba 0.2 na 0.3 omu muringo gw'ebicweka, reero babihandiike aha bicweka by'emigongo. Obuhererwa, obagambire kugyeragyeranisa ebicweka ebi omu nshura yaabyo.
answer_c: Shaba abeegi kweshushani ekyasha kya kyasha ekirikukiira kimwe, reero bakigaaburemu emisingi ikumi ehikwaniire oburaingwa. Bwanyima, bashemereire kuhandiika 0.1, 0.2,... 0.9 omuri gyeena aha musingi. Obuhikiro, obwo bashemereire kurangiira 0.2 na 0.3 omu ibara eritajwaniire.
answer_d: Shaba abeshomesa kushushani enyegyesereza nkooto shatu. Ebiri ez'okubanza ziteekwa kugaburwamu emisingi ikumi eringaanire, kandi omuri buri gumwe, bashuure emisingi erikukurirana na 0.2 na 0.3, omu butunu. Eya kashatu eteekwa kugaburwamu emigongo ikumi n'emisingi ikumi kandi bashuure obushushani buto oburikukurirana na 0.21. Aha muheru, obagambire kukwatanisa ebishushani ebyakozirwe.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’ekicweka kya 3 omu iraaya, akagendererwa ke omu ishomero kwabaana be kugarukamu ebikaguzo by’omubazi kuruga omu mizano y’omutaano y’ebicuupa. Habw’ekyo, bakahimba ebikaguzo ebirukubaasa kugarukwamu kuraba omu kugezesa. Ekikaguzo ki aha bikaguzo ebi, ekihimbirwe omwegyesa habwa abaana be, kirimu okukora okugezesa kw’omutaano kukigarukamu?
answer_a: Waaba orashe omukubo gw'ekicuuba emirundi makumi abiri, emirundi emeka enyima z'obuso oburikuhika omubaro musanju?
answer_b: Waaba orashe omukubo emirundi makumi ashatu, emirundi engaha omushanju guraaza ahaiguru?
answer_c: Waaba orashe omukubo gw'okushushura emirundi makumi abiri, obungi bw'amanota agusingura obu amaisho agy'ahaiguru gasobora kwombeka nigabari?
answer_d: Waaba orashe omukubo emirundi makumi ashatu, nobukuru ki obw'okuba eby'omumaiso byona nibikora obutari bw'amanota makumi ashatu?

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’ekibiina kya 3 okuramutsa okumanya kw’abegi be okubanga bakozeseza kubahaati eza baa yaaka ezirikugyenda omumaisho. Omu bintu ebiri ahansi, nikikii ekirikworeka omukoro ogu omwegyesa ashemereire kureeba kumanya yaaba abegi be batungwire ebirikukurataho?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza data ebaakungaaniziibwe kwombeka ekicweka ky'omugamba kirikworeka omutaano.
answer_b: Nibarikiriza omugano oguhikire aha migongo y'ekicweka ky'omugasho kurugiirira aha data erimu.
answer_c: Nibakora enteekanisa y'ebyahandiikirwe ebirikukorwa omu muringo ogurikusiima batakagyezaho kubishushaniisa omu caati erimu omugano.
answer_d: Nibakora orupapura rw'okubuuza erubasobozesa kutunga data erikumara kukora ekicweka ky'omugamba ekirikworeka omutaano.

question: Omuhiga omu, omuhiga w’ekinaana ari kukora aha kiragiro ky’ekibiina “Kumanya omuringo gw’okubara ogurikwemerera kucumura ekizibu ekirikwetenga okwongyera nari okukugyaho omuhendo oguri ahagati ya 0 kuhika 100.” Ni enki aha bikorwa ebi erikwemerera abegi kukura obureezi bw’okureeberaho obu bari kukora aha kiragiro eki kirikumanyisa?

question: Omugyezibwa orugaaha rw'abegi abari omu mwaka gw'ababili nagira ngu abe n'ekigyendererwa ky'okubaha ekizibu ekirikubasobozesa kwetegyereza enshuraniso eri ahagati y'okukoresa ebipimo ebitali biragiro n'ebiri omu biragiro. answer_a: Josefa naapima obuhangari bw'ekicweka n'enteera. Yaaza kucipima arikuta ekigyere kimwe omuhanda ogundi, omuhendo gw'enteera guraabe guri mwingi, muto, nari guri gumu? Habwaki?
answer_b: Felipe nagira ngu ekikaali kiina obureingwa bw'entaanira 35. Marcela yamugarukamu ngu n'eshuba, ahabw'okuba nawe yapimire kandi yagira entaanira 37 n'ekicweka. Nibakora bata kushanga obureingwa bw'amazima bw'ekikaali?
answer_c: Camila akakora mita omu kaadiiboodi, yaagigyerera omu sentimita, reero agikoresa kupima obuhangariire n'oburaingwa bw'emeza ye. Enrique nawe akakora ekintu kye kimwe n'omuleezi ogugyerere omu sentimita. Okupima oku kwaha kwija kuba okuhikire? Habwaki?

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’ekibiina kya 2 omuhendo gw’ebirikubamu (geometry) kandi naija kutebeekaho omurimo ogurikwija kumworeka obwinganisa bw’okumanya abegi be baraabe batungireho omu kubuganisibwa kw’ebishushani bya 2D. question: Omu omukuru omu iraasa rya Grade 3, omugyezibwa naaba naakora eishomo arikugyenda aine ekigyendererwa ky'okureetera abeeshuri kumanya empimo z'omutwe omu byaro byabo kandi bagyerereze obunene bwazo, nibakoresa empimo za 45◦ na 90◦ nk'eky'okureeberaho. answer_c: Yoreka aha kaadi ekishushani ekirikugyererana n'okukyuka omu kaicweka! Ni mu mbeera ki endiijo ei waabaire orikumanya okukyuka omu kaicweka?
answer_d: Yoreka okwo kweshushura okurikugyerera aha kucweeka omuringo omuhanda omuzaano! Okucweeka omuringo omuhanda nikukwatana n'engyesera erikukira nari etarikukira 90◦?

answer_b: Emilia yorekwa ebyangaana bina, arabireho yaagamba omuhendo gwabyo. Bwanyima, ebyangaana bishatu nibyongyerwaho kandi yabuzibwa: Ni ebyangaana bingahi byona hamwe ebindiho? Emilia nagamba ngu harimu ebyangaana mushanju.
answer_c: Javiera yorekwa omuhendo gw'eby'okutsindika bitaano, areeba omuri byo yaagira ngu biitaano. Bwanyima, arekwirwa emigo gye ice cream mukaaga, yaabuzibwa: omuhendo gw'ebintu oguri omu kibinja eki guri guta? kandi naabara kimwe aha kindi yaagira ngu biri mukaaga.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’omwaka ogw’abiri owa siniya ari kutebeekaniza isomo eririmu ekigyendererwa ky’okubaasa “kucumura ebizibu kuraba omu kubara okutahikiriire okw’omurongo ogumu”. Twaba niturora ngu omu masomo agahweire bacumwire okubara okutahikiriire omu murongo gumwe, niki aha mirimo ekirikubaasa kukorwa omu kukuza isomo, turikugumizamu n’ekigyendererwa ekyagambirwe?
answer_a: Kukora omulingo gw'okutasingana okurugiira omu kubaza ebishushani n'okushwijuma ebirugiremu.
answer_b: Yoreka ekizibu, hamu n'abeeshuri, mureke tureebere hamu omuringo gw'okukora oburingaaniza oburikubaasa kukoresibwa kukimara nookukitwariza omu bishushani.
answer_c: Shobooki obubonero bw'okutahikiriira hamu n'okushoboorora emigyenzo ey'omuganyizo ogu ekintu ekirikubahinduka kirikubaasa kutwara, twaba twine embeera.
answer_d: Yoreka omugano gw'obutahikiriire kandi ogumare omu rurengo orukuru ogwo ogurikureeta obugumu, kwongyera aha bumanyi obwaitu obw'enyima.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’omu mwaka ogwa 10 akamala orubaju orurikukwata aha namba eziriho buzima kandi yaacwireho kucungura oba abeeshuri bategeerize enjura enkuru erikutaana aha namba ezitarikugwaaho n’ezirikugwaaho. Ni murimo ki aha mirimo erikukurira enungi munonga aha beeshuri ahabw’ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a: Kushoborora kandi ohabure entambika ezirikwetagisa okuhindura ekicweka omu namba y'ekumi, n'okugarura enamba y'ekumi omu kicweka.
answer_b: Taaha emiringo y'emibaare y'ekumi erikugwa omu kaso, erikugwa omu kaso obutoosha, n'eterikugwa omu kaso, orikwoleka enshaanjuura ahaagati yaayo.
answer_c: Shuuruura emwe omu kibina ky'emibaro egiherize omu muringo gw'omutaano, orondoorere kandi ohabure omuringo ogukozirwe.
answer_d: Shobora emwe omu mutindo gw'emibaro y'amazima omu muringo gw'ebicweka kandi oshoborore embeera egi kuhindura nikibaasika

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’omu mwaka ogw’ekumi na gumu ari kutebeekaniza isomo eririkugira ekigyendererwa ky’okumanya “Okushobora kwolekya omu obusinge obw’ekifaananyi omurimo ogurikugarurwa ogw’omurimo ogurikugarurwa ogurikwolekwa omu businge obw’ekifaananyi”. Obushobozi oburikukurikira obuhe abegyeswa bashemereire kuba barikumanyire kubaasa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki kirikutebeekanisibwa?
answer_a: Kugonjora ebiragiro by'ebibarizo bya aligebra
answer_b: Kushushani emikorongooti kuruga omu meza y'ebibaririzo.
answer_c: Kureetera ebishushani omu mwanya gwabyo kurugiirira aha murongo
answer_d: Kureebereza ebishushani otabireho akacuuba kamwe

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa mwaka ogw'okubanza omuishomero erikuru ari kutebeekaniza eishomo eririkumanyisa 'Kukuza ekishushani ky'omukwato gw'ebiri omu muringo gw'ebishushani n'obubonero'. Ni bumanyi ki abeeshuri bashemereire kuba bamaze kwega kubaasa kukora aha bigendererwa ebi?
answer_a: Kucumya omuhendo gw'ebigambo by'ekibalangulo
answer_b: Okugyeragura omuhendo gw'ebigambo by'ekibalangulo
answer_c: Okukoresa emisingi y'amaani omu alijebra
answer_d: Okutwariramu kuruga omu rurimi orwa butoosha okugyenda omu rurimi rw'ebibarizo

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’eky’abiri oruganda orurikukurataho: “Kuragura ekirikubaasa kubaho aha muringo gw’amaizi gw’omubumbo bw’amaizi gw’omuringo ogurikwimurwa omu kintu ekindi ekirikugyemera”. Ebikorwa ebiri aha bw’amunsi nibiha ebirikubaasa kukoresibwa abeeshuri kukora kugira ngu batungye ekigyendererwa ekirikugambwaho?
answer_a: Ekyabaireho aha muringo gw'amaizi gurikwingana gurikugwiirwa omu kintu ekindi, no kubishushaniisa omu kabooki kaabo.
answer_b: Yoreka ebirugirwa ebi barikubaasa kutunga baraakubiire amazi omu byombo bishatu ebirikumaraana, reero obihameze.
answer_c: Tebeekanisa omulingo gw'okukora ekigezo ekikye, omuli okushomesa abegi kupima obwingi bw'amaizi n'okuguteeka omu byombo bitari bimwe, nibahandiika ebyo barikureeba.
answer_d: Manya ngu omuhendo gw'amaizi nigugumaho guri gumu bwanyima y'okugyenda n'omucece gwago omu byanzi ebirikumara, reero mugabane ebirivaamu omu nteerane nkuru.

question: Ni rikuru ki erikukuratira kurungi kutandika kukoresa omu kworeka omuhendo gw'emibaro erimu ebinduzo bibiri (two-digit numbers) omu mwanya gwabyo omu kiraasi ya P2?

answer_b: Ebicwe ya 10 shilingi na 1 shilingi
answer_c: Obumegye bw'amabara abiri agyenzire
answer_d: Ekyapa ky'omwanya n'emiringo erikugyibwaho

question:
Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'eky'okubanza aronganisa emirimo y'abeeshuri kushobora kumanya obumwe n'amakumi omu namba kuruga 0 kuhika 20.
Omu mirimo ekurikukuraho, oruhe orurikwongyera aha kwetegyereza kw'abeeshuri aha biteekateeko by'amakumi?
answer_a: Bara omuhendo gw'ebintu byona ebiri omu kibina ekiine ebintu ebirikukira omuhanda.
answer_b: Yoreka omuhendo gw'emitwaro ya 10 eyakubazibwa kuruga omuhendo gw'ebintu ebi orikugabwa.
answer_c: Shushani ebintu ebirikubura omu kibina kubaasa kuhikiiriza omubaro ogukira omuhanda.
answer_d: Bariirira omuhendo gw'ebintu ebiri omu kibina orikukoresa ekibina ky'ebintu 10 nk'eky'okureeberaho.

question:
Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omw’eishomero ry’abana abari omu mwaka ogw’abiri akagambira abegi be ngu baine kucwamu enamba kuruga ahari 0 kuhika 100.
Ni kikuru ki aha bikurikiyo ekirikwija kureka omwegyesa kumanya yaaba abegi bahikiire aha kigyendererwa eki yaabaire yagambire?
answer_a: Hanga namba ezitari kukira 100 n'ebishushani ebizirikwakiikirira
answer_b: Manya namba ezirikwija omuhanda oba enyima y'enamba eihaire ahansi ya 100
answer_c: Gyeitura omu mikato n'ebicweka ebiine omubaro ogurikukurirana oguri ahansi ya 100 omu mikato n'obumwe.
answer_d: Kukora ebizibu by'okubara omuhendo gw'emibaro eri ahansi ya 100 orikukoresa omurongo gw'emibaro

question: Omwegyesa omwegyesi w’ekicweka kya 3 akakolire n’abegi be aha kworeka okukubisa nk’okwongyera kuraingwa kandi akakora okucungura kw’ebyo barikwega. Omu kucungura oku, abegi bakaba baine kuhandiika okukubisa okukozirwe, okukworera kuraba omu kwongyera kw’ebintu ebiringaine, n’okukworera omu bigambo by’omuringo gw’okukubisa omu buzibu oburikukomezebwa. Ku yaareebiremu, omwegyesi akareeba ngu omwe ahairwe eky’okugarukamu ekirikukurata aha buzibu: Obuzibu: Ku ndikugira enkoko 6 kandi buli emwe eine amaguru abiri, maguru gangahi agoona? Eky’okugarukamu: 2·6=6+6=12 "Ebiri emirundi mukaaga". N’obu ekyarugiremu kyaba kirungi, ni ki aha bigambo ebi ebirikukurataho ekyahereza omwegi amakuru agataireho kumusobozesa kushoborora data omu buzibu obu?
answer_a: Oshemereire omuhendo ogurikukiraho, kwonka hariho omuringo ogundi gw'okushoborora ekizibu eki? Baaza ekishushani ky'embeera egi reero ogishaanise n'eby'oraazire. Hati harimu enshaaniso yoona?
answer_b: Ebirungi ebi waagarukize, kwonka orikwĳuka ngu omu muringo gw’okubaaza emirundi 2 omuri 6 nikushushana n’emirundi 6 omuri 2? Nibishushana, kwonka tibirikushushana omu kibazo eki. Okyetegyereize?
answer_c: Ebyarugaito nibyo birungi, kwonka orikuteekateeka noikiriza ngu okwolekya okwingana okurikukoresa okwongyera kw'ebintu ebi orikwenda byona? Reebera ngu ohandiike "2 emirundi 6" hatariho "6 emirundi 2"
answer_d: Omubaro ogu obaire obarire nigwo murungi, kwonka nohamiza ngu okurondaana n'entambwe zoona ezirikukoresibwa kukomora ekizibu? Shwijuma obone entambwe ei orabireho.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’eky’omunaana, orikubaire naakora aha kwongyera kw’enamba ezirihoona n’abegyi be, nayenda kworeka omuringo ogutungiireho ogw’okwongyera okubara ebirugiremu by’enamba z’ebicweka bishatu n’enamba y’ekicweka kimwe. Ni muringo ki ogu omwegyesa arikubaasa kutebeekanisa kwanguhya okwetegyereza kw’abegyi omuringo ogu nk’omuringo murungi oguhweiremu obucweka?
answer_a: Okutaanura omubazi orikugira emigyera eshatu kurugiirira aha muhendo gw'ebifo by'emyera yaagwo, kwongereza hamwe ebikorwa ahaagati y'emihendo egi n'omubazi orikugira omugyera gumwe.
answer_b: Okureetera omubazi ogw’ebicweka bisatu n’ebintu ebirikukwata ahari, ebirikukwiza kubara, kubaasa kubara emirundi mingi nk’oku omubazi ogw’ekicweka kimwe gurikworeka.
answer_c: Okugattaganya okurikukurwaana kw'ekicweka ky'omubaro ky'ebicweka bishatu kugira ngu kihuurirane n'omubaro gw'emirundi omubaro ogu gurikugarukwamu nk'ogurikugattwaho aha kicweka ky'omubaro ky'ekicweka kimwe.
answer_d: Kukora omurongo gw'okubaza emirundi okuruga aha namba emwe erikubazibwa n'enamba emwe, reero enamba ibiri erikubazibwa n'enamba emwe, kuhika aha namba ishatu erikubazibwa n'enamba emwe

question:

answer_d: Okuteera omuhanda n'okukurikirana kw'omuringo

question:
Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omuhereza ari kukora aha namba kuruga omuri emwe kuhika omu ikumi, naragiira abaana kujjuza orukurato rw'enamba kuraba omu rweshongo "Enjojo Emwe Eremeerera". Bwanyima, kukora aha buningi, nabeta omu rubaraza kweshamba nk'enjojo.

Omu mbeera erikwolekyerwa, omuzano ki aha mizaano erikukurira kwikiriza kukora aha musingi gw'obuningi?
answer_a: Taaha amaka g'enzovu, orondekanye omuhendo ogurikworekwa omwegyesa.
answer_b: Teebereza obuhendo orugyendo rw'enjojo, okubalirira obwingana bw'enteera ezi erikutwara kuhikaayo.
answer_c: Genda omuhanda gw'enzovu, obare ebigyenda byazo kurugiirira aha muhendo ogurikworekwa omwegyesa
answer_d: Teera enjojo omu mirongo, nibeteekanisa kuruga aha zirikukirayo kuhika aha zirikutoosha nari kuruga aha zirikutoosha kuhika aha zirikukirayo, nk'oku omwegyesa arikworeka.

question: Omwegyeegi w’omumwaaka gwa munaana ari kukora n’abeeshuri be aha kwazaana n’okugabura enamba ezirikukwata omutwe. Omu bwiire bw’eklassi, omweeshuri agira ati: “Ku ndikwazaana enamba nungi ibiri, obutoosha ngya kutunga eky’okugarukamu ekirikukira enamba ezo. Mbwenu nikyo kimwe kirikukora ku ndikwazaana enamba nungi ibiri ezirikukwata omutwe?” Ni ndyoha enyegyesa ezi omwegyesa arikukoresa ezirikugarukamu omweeshuri omu muringo ogurikwetenga, kandi obumwe, zigumya okwetegyereza ebirikugambwaho omu klassi?
answer_a: Ekibiina ky'emibaare y'omutindo kiragazi bw'ekibiina ky'emibaare eya butonde; n'ekyo ahabw'ekyo, omugabo gw'emibaare y'omutindo erukuzire nigugumaho emicwe gyagwo. Ka tugarukyemu nk'eky'okureeberaho omugabo gwa \(\frac{7}{3} \cdot \frac{5}{2}\)
answer_b: Okurikurirana n'ekirikugamba, ebirugire omu kwongyera namba ezirikukora gye buri obutoora nibiba birikukora gye; n'ahabw'ekyo, ebirugire omu kwongyera namba ezirikugaburwa nabyo nibihikiiriza omugisha ogu. Ka tushoborore nk'eky'okureeberaho ebirugire omu kwongyera \(\frac{7}{2} \cdot \frac{5}{3}\)
answer_c: Eky'omugabo gw'emibaare mirungi nikikira ebintu ebigurikugukora, kwonka byombi nibiba bikira omwe; n'ahabw'ekyo, nikikumara ekintu kimwe kukyeeya omwe kuba eki tikirikubaasa kubaho. Ka tugarukyemu nk'eky'okureeberaho omugabo gwa \(\frac{3}{4} \cdot \frac{5}{2}\)
answer_d: Okureebya omuhendo gw'ebicweka bibiri birungi nikikwatana n'okureebya aha kikomo kyabyo; n'ahabw'ekyo, ebirivaamu bishemereire kuba bitari bingi nk'ebyo. Ka tugarukyemu nk'eky'okureeberaho omuhendo gwa \(\frac{3}{4} \cdot \frac{2}{5}\)

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa P7 ari kukora aha biteekateeko by'omugyigyo gw'omubaro (absolute value) omu mibaro etarikwetenga (integers). Obu arikukora enywaniso z'emyitooro ei yaahandiikire aha kaadi, omwegi abuuza omwegyesa: "Ahabw'enki ebirugamu birikuba bibi obu harimu akamanyiso k'ekibi omu maisho g'omugyigyo gw'omubaro? Ogyereire ngu omugyigyo gw'omubaro gwona guraija gwa mazima, reero tindikwetegyereza ahabw'enki kirikuba kityo." Omu nyegyesereza ezi orikurugaho, niki ekirikugarukamu ekibuuzo eki omu muringo ogurikwetegyerwa omwegi wa P7?
answer_a: Akamanyiso k'okuhakanisa enyima y'ekigambo nikimanyisa "omugatte ogurikuhakanisa ogwa." Obwo oburemeezi butarikwetenga obutoora buri buri obwire bukuru nari obulingaaniza na zeero, omugatte gwabwo ogurikuhakanisa buri obwire guraabe muto nari ogulingaaniza na zeero.
answer_b: Akamanyiso k'okuhakanisa enyima y'ekigambo nikimanyisa "okuhindura akamanyiso." Obu omuhendo ogutariho nk'ogwo buri buri obwire gukira nari gulingana na zeero, okuhindura akamanyiso buli obwire nikireeta omuhendo ogutari munene kulingana nari okucwa ahansi ya zeero.
answer_c: Akamanyiso k'okuhakanisa enyima y'ekigambo nikiringana n'okukoresa amateeka g'akamanyiso omu kwongyera kw'emiringo. Obwo omuganyiro ogutariho nk'omuringo buri obutooba buri obukuru kukira nari okuringana na zeero, ahabw'okuba "ekirikukwata aha murundi n'ekirikuhakanisa nikirikuhakanisa," ebirivaamu buri obutooba biriba bitari bikuru kukira nari okuringana na zeero.
answer_d: Akamanyiso k’okuhakanisa enyima y’ekigambo nikiringana n’okugira omubaro muhakanisi enyima y’ebizingo. Obwo obungi butarikushobora kwihaho buri obutooba obutooba nari oburinganiza zero kandi akamanyiso k’okuhakanisa nikihindura akamanyiso omunda y’ebizingo, omugabo gwakyo buri obutooba obutooba nari oburinganiza zero.

Omu mirimo egi erikukurataho n'ogu orikukwatagana n'ekigyendererwa ky'okwegyesa kandi oguragira okuhinduka kw'ekifo?

answer_c: Shuuruza ebiiri ebirikukuratanisa ebiri omukikorwa ky'omugisho
answer_d: Tebeekanisa omuhanda ogurikworeka omukoro omu buringaniza.

question: Omugyezibwa naaba naakora aha bigyendererwa ebi n'abeshomesa b'ekiro 8: "Kwetegyereza omusingi gw'okugazya omuhendo gw'okubanzaana", kandi naija kutebeekanisa omurimo gw'okutandika ekika kye. Aha mirimo ei erikukurira, oruhe orurikwija kuleetera abeshomesa kwetegyereza omusingi ogu?
answer_a: Gambura omubazo gw'okugatta hamwe oburikubaaho twaba turikuta omucwezi gw'ebicweka bibiri
answer_b: Gyeragura omugisha gw'ekintu ekirikwetagisa okucweka esente n'okucweka edaisi
answer_c: Shaza omuhanda gw'eby'omugugu ogurikuruga omu kuteera obucweka bubiri bw'entaama, orikukoresa emiringo ehikire
answer_d: Sharamura omwanya gw'ebirikuruga omu kucweeka eicumu n'omutaano, orikukoresa ekishushani ky'omuti.

question:
Omugyezaho w’omukaaga ari kukora n’abeshuri be aha myolesyo erimu okwongyera aha bicweka ebirimu ababazi abatahwera kandi areeba ngu abeshuri abamwe nibakora enshobi egi:

2/3 + 1/2 = (2+1) /( 3+2) = 4/5 = 3/7

Twaba nitureeba embeera eri ahaiguru, ni bumwe aha bwakorwa oburikwija kwikiriza abeshuri kwetegyereza n’okukoresa omuze gw’okwongyera aha bicweka ebirimu ababazi abatahwera?
answer_a: Shanga enamba zoona omuri omurongo gw'enamba, orondere obureiyo bwazo kuruga ahari zero, kandi orugyire omu kubiita kw'obureiyo obu, otungye omwanya gw'ekirikugarukwamu aha murongo. Hanyuma, yoreka omugabo ogurikuhikaana naagwo, omarize omugisha.
answer_b: Gamba omuko gw'okukora n'eky'okureeberaho ekirikukwata aha mazima kushuuruura enshobi. Reero, okore aha kukura kw'ebimanyiso orikukuzya buri kimwe aha birikugattwa omu myoleso kugira ngu okigatte n'omugano gw'ebicweka ebirikufaanana kandi okimare n'omugabane gumwe ogurikukwatanisa.
answer_c: Ongyera omuringo gw'okwongyera obucweka obutaine omugano gumwe, orikukoresa eby'okureeberaho ebindi, abeeshuri bategeere omuringo ogu kuraba omu kwega. Reero, obagambire bagarukyemu omu myitooro.
answer_d: Teera aine by’omuti mukaaga (6) n’ebindi bine (4). Obuti bwona hamwe bwaba butaaha? Handiika eky’okugaragaza ekyo omuhendo.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'eky'omushanju ari kutebeekaniza ishomero eririkukwata aha kigyendererwa "Kuceekereza emigabo efaanaine omu bigambo by'ebibarizo". Ni by'okwega ki abeeshuri bashemereire kuba bamaze kwega kubaasa kukora ekigyendererwa ky'ishomero?
answer_a: 1) Kucumura emirizo n'enamba ezijumbwire n'enamba ezirimu omugabo murungi. 2) Yerinda ebirikukora ekicweka ky'ekigambo n'eky'omugambwa gw'ebara.
answer_b: 1) Kubarura ebikwatiraine n'emibaro y'emiringo n'enamba ezirikwenda omuhanda. 2) Kuhindura ebigambo kuruga omu rurimi orwa butoosha okubihindura omu rurimi rw'emibaro, n'okugarukira haihi.
answer_c: 1) Yoreka ebintu ebiri omu kigambo n'ebiri omu mweshongoro gw'ebibarizo. 2) Hindura emyeshongoro kuruga omu rurimi rwa buriijo okugyenda omu rurimi rw'ebibarizo, n'okugaruka.
answer_d: 1) Kucumura eby'okubara n'integya hamwe n'enamba ezirimu omugabo murungi. 2) Kworeka ebigambo by'alijebra ebirikworoora omu muringo ogurikukwataho, omu bishushani, n'omu bishusho.

question:
Omwegyesereza omwegyesa kukoragana n'abeeshuri be ab'omu mwaka ogwa 7 aha mugingo gw'okwega ogurikukwata aha kwetegyereza ekirikurunga nk'ekifo ky'ebirikugyerwa, n'okubara obukuru bw'enkungu yaakyo n'obukuru bw'obwihisho bwaakyo.
Okumanya ki okurikukurira omu by'obutare n'Algebra okurikubaasa kuhuzibwa n'emigingo y'ebirikugyerwa egiirikukorwaho omu mugingo ogu?
answer_a: Okutangira enamba ezitarikuhikiirira harimu n’omugabo gwa π
answer_b: Omuringanizo ogutari gumwe nigugyenda gutyo: Omugano gw'ahagati y'obunene n'omugyera gw'ekizingirizi
answer_c: Okukora n'emibaro y'enamba ezirikukoresa akakomo (decimal numbers) okwetegyereza ebipimo by'obureezi.
answer_d: Omuringanizo oguhikire niguhuza oruziga n'obuhangari bw'omuringo.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesi w’eky’omunaana akoreire hamwe n’abegyi be aha ngyenderwaho ezirikushushana n’okukoresa emiringo y’omurongo oguhangaanire n’ogutahangaanire, kandi aha muheru gw’ekicweka eki, baryakora okushwijuma okurikugyenderera aha byo baayegire. Omu kushwijuma, omwegyesi arakuza ekizibu eki: Omu duka ly’ebitabo, Marta akagura ebisyani 4 ah’eisente 3160, kandi buri kisyani kikaba kine omuguzi gumwe. Ku kimwe aha birikumanyisa ebirikushwijumwa omu kikoreso eki kirikugyendera aha mukago oguri hagati y’omugano ogutwaire n’omurongo oguhangaanire, orukurato oruhaireho rw’emyitooro nirwija kuha obuhame oburikukwata aha kutuura kw’ekirikumanyisibwa eki?
answer_a: 1) Sharamura y'okushobora kumanya ebigambo ebirikugamba aha muhendo gw'entaama ezigulirwe n. 2) Ni muringo ki gw'omugano ogurikukwatanisa embeera z'omuhendo n'obwingi bw'entaama?
answer_b: 1) Baigarukye taabulo y'ebibarizo erimu omuhendo gw'okushashura oshohora kugura ebirangiti 2, 3, 4, 5, na 6, buri kimwe, n'ebibarizo ebi nibyo bikwatana butoosha. 2) Ni mutindo ki gw'omukora, ogw'omurongozi nari ogwa afiine, ogukwatanisa ebibarizo by'omu taabulo eyo ya ira?
answer_c: 1) Sharamura y'omugambo gw'ekibarango ekirikushobora kworeka omukago oguri ahagati y'omubaro gw'ebirangiro ebigulirwe n'omubaro gw'eizooba eryaheirwe. 2) Ni kintu ki ekiri omu mugambo gw'ekibarango ogwabuzire ekirikukwatanisa n'omutaano gw'omuringanizo ogurikworeka embeera zombi?
answer_d: 1) Yoreka omukono ogurikworeka omukago oguri ahagati y'omubazi gw'ebiragiro ebiguzirwe n'omutaango ogwishurirwe. 2) Niki ekintu ekihuriire ekirikworeka omukago oguri ahagati y'omutaango n'omubazi gw'ebiragiro?

question:
Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'eky'omunaana n'abegi be aha bikwatiraine n'okubazamu ebigambo by'omubalanguzi, kuraba omu kwoleka obukuru n'orimi rw'omubalanguzi. Kutiisa obuhame bw'omulingo abegi barikwegamu, bakozeseze okusesa okurikukwata aha nshonga egi. Yetegyereza eky'omwegi omwe arikugarukamu ekibuuzo ekiri omu kusesa:
·
Sharamura omukuru P n'obukuru A bw'ekyangaali, orubaju rwaalyo rurikupima (x + 2) cm.
·
Okukura: P=4 (x+2)=4x+8
Okukura: A=(x+2)2=x2+4
Eky'okugarukamu: Obukuru ni (x2+4)cm2 n'omukuru ni (4x+8)cm.
Ni ki aha bigambo ebi omwegyesa arakuheereza omwegi ebirikumuhwera kutunguura omulingo arikukora omu mulingo ogu?
answer_a: Reeba oreebwe, ahabw'okuba kimwe aha by'okugarukamu bibiri nikyo kirungi ekindi tikirungi. Ninkuhanuura kukoresa omuringo gw'okubaza omukubo gw'ekyanya ekikwata aha binomia kurengyesereza.
answer_b: Obwahatiiremu omukingizo omuhanda gwona, kwonka okakora enshobi omu kubara obukuru bw'ekibanja, ahabw'okuba omuringo gw'okubara sikweya ya binomiyo ni (a+b)2 =a2+2ab+b2
answer_c: Noona okareebire omuhendo gw'okwetorora ekintu omuhanda murungi, okakozeseze enshobi kukora omuhendo gw'obukuru bw'ekintu. · Yanduurura (x+2)2 nka (x+2) (x+2) obone obukuru bw'ekintu bwona obuundi.
answer_d: Reeba omugani gwaawe, ahakuba kimwe aha by'okugarukamu kibiine nikyo kirungi ekindi tikirungi. Shoma omurundi ogundi oreebe okigarukye, omurundi ogu orikuta omutima aha bigambo by'omubaro byoona.

question: Omwana omu atooroire omu omusomo gw'abaana bato abeiteireho, naazaana aha kantu akakorerwaho emirimo aine kaadi mushanju. Zoona zirikugira omutima omukuru omumyufu, kwonka emitwarize yaabyo neehinduka kuruga omu myufu mwingi munonga okuhika omu myufu murikire. Omwana, bwamara kureeba kaadi ezi, naazitebeekanisiza kuruga aha kaadi erimu omutima omumyufu mwingi munonga okuhika aha eri omutima omumyufu ogurikurika. Bumanyi ki oburikukwata aha muko gw'omwana ogu?
answer_a: Tebeekanisa omutendera
answer_b: Kurōngaanisa omurōngo gw'ebintu ebiriho omuringo ogurikukurataana
answer_c: Taaba omu mitwaro.
answer_d: Kushushanisa omwe n'omundi

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa klasse ya 4 owaakozire n'abegyi be aha mukago oguri hagati y'obureme n'omuringo gw'ebintu, ahwaireho orushozi arikworeka obupiira buna oburikushushana omu bunene kwonka burimu ebintu bitari bimwe: raba, ebibumba, ecupa, na sitaari. Hanyuma ababuuza: "Kurugiira aha byo twareebire, omukago guri guta hagati y'obureme n'omuringo gw'ebintu ebi?" Abegyi abarikukira obwingi bagarukamu ngu ahabw'okuba obupiira boona nibashushana omu bunene, baine omuzingo gumwe, n'ahabw'ekyo obureme bushemereire kuba bumwe. Ni ebikorwa ki ebiraabaasa kukorwa abegyi omu rushozi orurikukuraho kwetegyereza omu buryo oburikwoorobi omuziingo oguri hagati y'obureme n'omuringo gw'ebintu?
answer_a: Taata omu omupiira omwe omu firasika erimu amaizi, oreebe omutaango ogwo ozaakutunga. Reero okore nk'ekyo kimwe n'emipiira endiijo. Eky'ahaheru, geranisiza ebiraakurugaamu, obihurikize n'ebikozesebwa omu kipiira yoona.
answer_b: Pimaaza ebirumbirizo 4 aha minzaani y'omuringo gw'omubazi, oreekye eby'orugaito. Reero ogeraanise eby'orugaito, obitangaanise n'ebintu ebi ebirumbirizo byakozirwamu. Aha muheru, ocwekyereze aha mukago oguri hagati y'eby'orugaito n'obwinganiza bw'ebirumbirizo.
answer_c: Taata omupiira omwe omwe omu, orukurwa orutaine ebirango kandi oteekeho akaroonda aha muhanda gw'amaizi agaruuga omu mupiira gwona. Aha muheru, geranisiza ebirugiremu kandi obihurirane n'oburemu bw'omupiira gwona.
answer_d: Ta omuteera omupiira gumwe omu kibaya kimwe ky'omuzaniizi, n'emy'indi eshatu omu kibaya ekindi, oreekodi ekiirikukora. Bwanyima, ta emipiira ebiri omu kibaya kimwe, n'emy'indi ebiri omu kindi, oreekodi ebirugaamu, n'ebindi nk'ebyo. Aha muheru, geranisiza ebyareekodirwe buri kasumi n'ebirikukozesibwa omu buri mupiira, obihurikize n'oburemeezi bwa buri gumwe.

question: Orikiriza ry'okwegyesa ery'eky'okubanza: "Geranisiza kandi oteekanise namba kuruga omu 0 kuhika 20 kuruga omu ntono kuhika omu nene nari obundi, okukoresa ebintu ebirikukwatwa nari puloguraamu za kompyuta z'eby'okwegyesa", orikiriza ki aha mairizo agarikukurataho erikuhikaana n'orikiriza ry'okwegyesa ery'enyima?
answer_a: Bariirira omuhendo gw'ebintu ebiri ahagati ya 1 na 20
answer_b: Shoma kandi oragye omuhendo gw'emibaro kuhika 20.
answer_c: Kugyenda hamu n'okutaanura namba okuhika 20
answer_d: Kukora omutwe gw'okubara omu bwijwire

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesi owa mushomere bw'okushatu n'abaana be aha mitero y'ebishushani bya 3D, kandi yaayombeka omurimo gw'okubahwera kumanya gye ebirikukwata aha matama, enshozi, n'enkingi. Ku yaheza kushoborra buri kimwe aha bintu ebi bisya birikumanyisa, abamwesereza ebishushani ebi bya 3D: [Ebifaananyi by'ekikomo, ekikoomi, n'ekibuubu] Omwegyesi ababuuza ati: "Ni kimwe ki aha bishushani ebi kirimu enshozi 6 omurundi gumwe?", abamwe aha baana bashobora kugarukamu bati: "Ekibuubu". Aha mirimo ekurikukurataho, ni guri ki ogurahwera abaana kwetegyereza gye ebirikukwata aha bintu ebi bisya?
answer_a: Huura ebishushani by'omubumbo eby'omurundi gwa kashatu n'ebintu by'amazima
answer_b: Yombeka ebishushani bya 3D ebirukire ahari neti zaabyo ezitari zimwe.
answer_c: Shuuruura ebiika by'oburinganire bwombi (2D) n'ebirikushushana nabyo omu buringanire bushatu (3D)
answer_d: Shuushanura ebintu ebirikukora ebishushani by'omutaano eby'omubumbo ebirikukora ebintu ebirikukoresibwa omu kubumba.

question: Omwegyesereza omukuru omu kicweka kya Nursery ekikyeeya arikutebeekaniza eby’okwegyera hamwe n’abegi be arikugyenda kukora aha bigendererwa ebi: - Omushingi gw’Okuteekateeka kw’Eshomo ry’Okubara: “Okutunga okumanya ngu ebintu n’abantu abakuru tibihinduka, kuraba omu mizaano n’ebintu ebirikukoresibwa buri izooba.” - Omushingi gw’Omubiri n’Okugyeengyeera: “Okukwatanisa okukora n’engaro omu kubiika ebintu omu mwanya ogurikukwata aha mubiri gwabo, nk’okureeta ebintu bikye haihi n’engaro nkuru n’akatookye.” Ni engyeso ki y’okwegyera erikukiraho kusiima omwegyesereza kukora aha bigendererwa ebi byombi?
answer_a: Fisa ebintu ebirimu emitwarize etali emwe omuhanda gwona, orarikirize abaana kucweecweenta omuhanda, bahuure ebintu ebihisirwe.
answer_b: Ha otyena ebitara by’ebintu ebirikukoresibwa buri izooba n’ebitara bindi birikushisha, reero ohingure abaana kwimutsya ebintu ebi, babihingure kandi babihereerezanye.
answer_c: Taata omuriika y'ebintu ebirimu ebintu ebirikushushana omu muringo ogutari gumwe omu kicweka, reero oite abaana kubikwata, kubihanganisa, n'okubitebeekanisa omu mitwaro.
answer_d: Leeta eby'akabiiti ebizigye birimu obutuli n'ebintu bitono ebi abana batoorana n'okubigyayo.

question: Omuhanda gw'abegyesa omu Kigo kya Senior Kindergarten omu kushoberera kw'omwaka gw'eshomero, nibarondamu ebikoresho by'okwegyesa ebi baraakoresa n'abaana kurugiirira aha kiragiro ky'okwega eki: "Okushobora kwolekya omuhendo n'obwingi omu muringo ogurikukwatwa n'ogurikushushaanwa." Ebikoresho by'okwegyesa ebiri aha hansi ebirikukurataho nibirikukwata aha mugasho gw'omutwe gw'abegyesa ogu?
answer_a: Eby'ebikoomi ebirimu obutooni: eby'ebikoomi bya pulasitiki ebirimu obutooni bw'amabara n'obunene obutari bumwe
answer_b: Emihendo y'omusenyu y'ebara: kaadi z'omukaraato eza sentimita 15 x 15, nuru eziriho okuva 0 kuhika 9 ez'omusenyu
answer_c: Empapura y'okukora emyito: oburango obw'akaleetaaine oburikugambira aha namba kuruga aha 1 kuhika aha 10. Empapura y'oburaingwa bw'ebaruha.
answer_d: Omutaano gw'ebitare: omutaano gw'ebitare eby'amafu, ogurimu namba okuva ahari 1 kuhika 9, ezirikwihaho. Buri kare ahari sentimita 30 x 30.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa Nursery naakora okwebeza kw'okumanya kw'abaana abato aha bikwaata aha kiragiro ky'okwegyesa ekirikugira ngu: "Kushwijuma okuraba omu kumanya kwabo n'omubiri, emitwarize y'ebintu," omunda y'Emiharizo y'Okuteekateeka kw'Eshomo ry'Ekibarizo. Ni engyenderwaho ki eyorikukwata omwegyesa okwebeza omulingo abegi batungireho ekiragiro eki ky'okwegyesa?
answer_a: Omu bwire bw'ekicweka, toorana kandi oteeke abaana omu mikono ebintu ebirimu ebintu ebitari bimwe omu miringo, oburemeezi, n'obunene
answer_b: Omu kasumi ky'okuramutsya, yoreka abana ebifaananyi by'ebintu ebirikushushana omu miringo: emibala, obunene
answer_c: Omu bwiire bw'okuhindura, yoreka abaana emitwaro etari emwe y'ebintu ebiine emiringo emihango nk'erangi n'emitero.
answer_d: Omu birungi by’okukora ebintu ebitari bimwe, kurora abaana bakuratirize kugura ebintu ebirukiraine omu kuwurira ebirukugambwaho: emiterere n’omugasho gwabyo

question: Omugyezibwa w’omwaka ogw’obushatu akagyezesa abegi be kureeba yaaba bakegyeera kumanya n’okushoboorora emiringo omu chati y’ekana (100 chart). Omu mirimo eyahairwe omu kugyezesa, akabashumbura echati nk’eri ahansi kandi ababuuza omuringo oguri omu rukurato orurikukorwa ebinyaguli ebirikwetengwa. Omwegi omwe akagarukamu ngu omuringo gukaba kwongyera 1. (Echati n’ebinyaguli kuruga 1 kuhika 100) Ni ki aha bigambo ebi omwegyesi arikubaasa kukoresa kumuhiga omwegi ogu kutunga ekigyendererwa?
answer_a: Ijuka twihwere omu muringo ogurikukuratana. Ninkushaba oragye omurongo gumwe omu kacati n'erangi emwe, n'omuganda gumwe n'erangi endiijo. Reebera emibaro eri omu buri murongo na buri muganda. Mibaro ki ehinduka omu murongo? Mibaro ki ehinduka omu muganda? Ninkukunda okore akacati kasya n'emiringo ei orabeire.
answer_b: Ijuka twikirize ngu nitukora aha miringo n'omutindo. Omu kacweka aka, noobaasa kureeba omutindo ogurikuratira omuringo ogwooreka omu kagaruko kaawe? Ninkushaba ogusingireho orangi. Hati, kiki ekyaraabeho twakozesa omuringo gw'okwongyeraho 17 aha mutindo ogurikukyerwa? Ninkukunda kushanga emitindo egi omu kacweka aka.
answer_c: Ijuka twijukye ngu turikukora aha muringo n'omutendera. Ninkushaba ogoobe n'erangi enumi z'omutendera ogurikukuzibwaho. Omutaano guri haihi yaabaire enumi y'okubanza n'eya kabiri? Kandi haihi yaabaire eya kabiri n'eya kashatu? Nikiija kuba kimwe waabara aha numi zoona ezi ogobire? Omuringo gw'omutendera ogu oreetsireho nigwija kuba guri guta? Geraageranya omuringo ogu n'ogu waahaire enyima
answer_d: Ijuka omu, niturikukora aha miringo n'omutendera. Yetegyereza ngu omu kacati ekarikwoleka harimu emitendera erikukira ogwo ogurikwolesibwa. Mitendera ki endiijo ei orikushanga? Ninkushaba ogyoleke n'amabara g'omutaano emitendera ei orikushanga omu bwima, omu burengwa n'obuhingurizi. Omuringo gwa buri gumwe nigukurata ki? Nigushushana guta kandi nigutaana guta? Miringo y'ekika eki turityeta tuta?

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa orikutebeekanisa amasomo agu ekigyendererwa ekirikukurira nikyo kigira kiti: "Kwetegyereza n'okukoresa emitwarize n'ebintu ebikwatiraine n'omuzingo." Obwo abeeshuri bari aha mutendera gw'okutandika kwega ekigyendererwa eki, omwegyesa acwireho kutandika n'eisomo eririkubareetera kuteebereza omuhendo gwa π. Aha mirimo erikukurira erikukorwa abeeshuri, niki ekirikubakonyera kukora aha kigyendererwa eki, twaba niturora ekigyendererwa ky'obwegyesa ekishoboirwe?
answer_a: Nibarikira kushaka ebiri aha namba π n’omukago gwayo n’enziga hamwe n’obukuru bw’enziga.
answer_b: Nibamara ebizibu ebitandika ebikwata ku kubara omuzingo n'obukuru bw'ekikarikizo.
answer_c: Nibarikira omuhendo ogurikuzinga hamwe n'obukuru bw'ekikungu (area) ky'ebikunizo ebirimu obunene obutari bumwe, nibakoresa omuhendo ogurikuhika haihi ogw'omubaro π.
answer_d: Baineza okuzimba omuzingo gw'ebiringiti ebirimu obunene obutari bumwe kandi bashobora kwetegyereza omukago oguli hagati y'omuzingo n'obunene bwago.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa owa mukaga ari kutebeekaniza isomo eriraabakorese aha kigyendererwa ky'okwega ekirikukurataho: "Okuteebereza aha muhendo gw'ebirikuruga omu kucweekereza emirundi mingi okucweekereza okumwe n'ebicweka, ensimbi, nari ebindi, omu mikono nari okukoresa programu za kompyuta ezirikwegyesa." Eki nikiraabakoresa, ekibiina nikiraagaburwa omu tubiina tw'abantu bashatu kandi nibaraakora omurimo kurabira omu bicweka. Okurora ngu abeeshuri bari omu ntandikiro y'okwega ebirimu ebi, omurimo ki ogurikukurataho ogurikukiriza okukora aha kigyendererwa ekirikutebeekanisibwa?
answer_a: Buri guluupu eshemere kukuba edaisi ikumi na ibiri omurundi kandi ehandiike obubonero eyafumire omu kukuba kwona. Bwanyima, abeeshuli bashemere kuteera enshonga aha muringo ogu ebyafumireho birikugyenda kandi bagabane n'eklassi yoona.
answer_b: Buri omukoki gushuubure edaiisi emirundi 120 kandi bakoree orutonde rw’obubonero obu baatooraine omuri buri kushuubura. Hanyuma, abeeshuri bashemereire kuteera enshonga aha muringo ogu eby’ebyaatoorainwe birikugyenda nibigumira kandi bagabane n’abashomerezi abandi.
answer_c: Buri kimu omukoki gushemereire kuteera amatafaari abiri omurundi gumu kandi bawandiike omuhendo gw'obutaama obu baagyiire, nibakora okucwekyereza oku emirundi 24. Hanyuma, abeeshuri bashemereire kuhandiika enshonga ezirikukurata omu by'okugarukamu ebi kandi bagabane n'eklassi yoona.
answer_d: Buri guriipu eshoora okuzinga edaisi ebiiri omurundi gumwe kandi bakarekooda omuhendo gw'obubonero ebyatungwa, nibakora okucwekyereza oku emirundi 120. Bwanyima, abeeshomerwa bashemereire kucweeka enshishoonaana aha miringo y'ebyava omu byo kandi bagigabane n'eklassi yoona.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’ekyangahe kya mukaaga n’abegyeswa be aha mutwe gw’emigano. Omu by’omwegyesa yaabaire yabayegyesa, akaba yabegyesize emiringo erikushobora kwolesa emigano. Omu kashomo aka, naareeba ngu noongyenda nk’abegyeswa baingi nibakora gye omu kubara emigano, tibarikwetegyereza enshuraniso eri ahagati ya a : b na a : (b : a), nk’eky’okureeberaho ahagati ya 1 : 2 na 2 : 1. Omwegyesa naashobora ata kushoboorora enshuraniso eri ahagati y’emigano egi ibiri, abegyeswa babashe kwetegyereza gye, kandi bakorese ebi baayegire omu kubara kwabo okurikwija?
answer_a: Okugamba emigeri yoona ebiri nk'emitwaro.
answer_b: Okugyerekana emigeri ebiri yoona kurabira omu tukarata tw'omuceere
answer_c: Kuta omugabo gw'omugera gw'emigerere yoona aha mukura gw'omubaro
answer_d: Okoresa omuringo ogurikukoresibwa omu magara gaa burizooba oburi kworeka oku emigeri yombi erikukora

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa n’abegyeswa aha kwaza emibaare mirungi. Okukora eki, nateekaniza isomo eririkwega aha kwaza ekibarokururwa n’ekicweka kirungi. Okurikurugiira aha bumanyiso bwe, enshobe emwe ebaireho obunyinzi abegyeswa barakora aha bigambo ebi nikuchangaanisa okwaza ekibarokururwa n’ekicweka n’okukikuza. Nk’eky’okureeberaho, omurimo nk’ogwa 10 . 3/4 guraijwe gukorwa nabo nk’ogwa 10 . 3/10 . 4. Ahabw’ekyo, omwegyesa acwireho kutandika isomo arikwegyesa aha kucangaana oku. Aha bikorwa ebi omwegyesa arakore, ni eki ki ekirikwija kuleetera abegyeswa kwetegyereza enshaanjuura aha miringo egi yoombiri?
answer_a: Yoreka omuhendo 3/4 emirundi ikumi reero yoreke omuhendo 30/40, oringaanise eby'okureeberaho ebi kureeba yaaba nibiringana nari kutaringana
answer_b: Reeta omwegyesa arikukoresa omuringo 10 . 3/4, yombeka ekizibu ky'okubara ekirikwombeka n'omuringo 10 . 3/10 . 4, yombeke ebyombi kandi oringaanise ebirugamu.
answer_c: Shobora eki ahabw'enki okugaziya ebicweka kutari nk'okukubisa omuhendo hagati y'ebihika n'ebicweka, noohereza eby'okureeberaho ebirikushoborora enshaaniso egi.
answer_d: Eihinduka omugabo gw'omubazi gw'omubaro ogw'obutonde n'ekicweka omu kicweka eki omubazi kyarooba

question: Omugyezaho n’omwegyesa aba nayetegekereza amasomo g’ekicweka kya Jiyometri; okukira munonga, esomo eryina ekigyendererwa eki: “Okukoresa omugenzo gwa Pythagorean omu kushanga obuhingiro bw’empande ezitarikumanywa omu mpande tatu ezirukumiramu, narugira ensonga z’omuringo ogurikukoresibwa.” Biki abeeshuri bashemereire kuba nibamanyire kare kubaasa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa eki?
answer_a:
1) Kuteerera obukuru bw'ebyango by'empindahantu.
2) Kuteerera obukuru bw'ebyango by'ebyango bine nk'omutanda.
3) Kukomora emiringo egihagazi.
answer_b:
1) Kwetegyereza emizi y'omubazo ey'obutonde.
2) Kwetegyereza obukuru bw'ensaafu z'empindahantu.
3) Kwetegyereza obukuru bw'ensaafu z'ebirabaane.
answer_c:
1) Kwetegyereza emizi y'omubazo ey'ebishushani by'obutonde.
2) Kwetegyereza obukuru bw'ebyangwa.
3) Kucumura emigariso erikuraba omu murongo.
answer_d:
1) Kwetegyereza emizi y'omukwato ey'enamba z'obutonde.
2) Kwetegyereza obukuru bw'ebicweka bya mpande shatu.
3) Kucumura emiringo egororo.

question: Omugyezibwa naayegyesa n'abegyesibwa omu kiraasi aha kigyendererwa: "Kwetegyereza amakuru g'okuhinduka kw'omuringo gw'ekicweka." Ni birikurugirira ki omwegyesa ashemereire kuteekateeka yaaba naashuuruura okwega okukozirweho, ahabw'okuba nikwohereza ngu ekigyendererwa nikikwanisa?
answer_a: Shuuruura obwingi obweyongyeireho nari obutandwa omu mbeera ezirikukwatanisa n'obumanyiso oburikukwata aha mbeera ezo.
answer_b: Kukora ebizibu ebirimu okubara okweyongyera nari okucweeka omu bintu ebirikukora omu magara gya butoosha
answer_c: Geranisiza okweyongyera nari okucweeka omuhendo omu mbeera ezirikukwata aha magara, orabe ngu nikukuyamba kukora ebicweka.
answer_d: Manya ebintu ebirikukwemerera kucumura ebizibu ebirikwetenga kubara okweyongera nari okucweeka omu bungi omu bitaanu omu kikumi

question: Omwegyesi w’ekika kya mukaaga ari kutebeekanisa isomo aha mutwe gw’ebirikupimwa. Omu isomo eryahweire, akakora aha biteekateeko by’obukuru bw’ebintu ebirimu emiteresho, kandi omu isomo eri naija kutandika kukora aha kiragiro ky’okwega ekirikukurataho: “Kubara obukuru bw’ensaanduuko, orikugambira ebirikuruga omu cm² na m².” Aha kutandika kw’isomo, naija kubaijutsya omuringo gw’okubara obukuru bw’ekintu eky’omurabaasa ngu, n’amanywe g’aha, bashobore kukora omwegyereeso gw’omurongo ogurikuhikaana n’ekigyendererwa ekigambirwe. N’okurora ekigyendererwa ky’obwegyesa eki, orukurato rw’emikora orukurataho nirwo ruraabe rurungi munonga ahabw’omwegyereeso ogu?
answer_a: 1) Nibenda omuhanda gw'okubara obukuru bw'ekintu eky'omutaano (cube) aha intaneeti kandi bashoboorore ebintu ebirikukikora. 2) Nibakora okwetegyereza kurikukwata aha kubara obukuru bw'ebintu by'emitaano (cubes), nibaha eby'okugarukamu byabo omuri cm² nari m², nk'oku kirikuba kyetaagisa. 3) Nibahindura ebipimo by'obukuru kuruga omuri cm² kuhika omuri m², n'okugaruka enyima.
answer_b: 1) Nibarikira eby'omubiri ebya kyubu omu klasirumu kandi bakashushaniira omutandiro gwabyo. 2) Babara obukuru bw'ebyo eby'omubiri bakoresa omuringo oguhairwe omwegyesa. 3) Bakora eby'okubara ebirimu obukuru bw'ekyubu, nibaha eby'okugarukamu byabo omu cm² nari m², nk'oku kirikwetagisa.
answer_c: 1) Nibarikiriza aha rutonde lw'emiramu orureetsirwe omwegyesa kubaasa kumanya oruguana n'obukare bw'ekibu. 2) Nibamanya ebindi by'omubiri ebirikugwana nk'ekibu omu klasiruumu kandi babarira obukare bwabyo. 3) Nibahindura ebipimo by'obukare kuruga omuri cm² okugyenda omuri m², na bwo obundi.
answer_d: 1) Nibakora omuringo gw'okubara obukuru bw'ekibu kubaasa kukigarura nk'ekikoomi. 2) Nibamanya ebintu ebirikushusha ekibu omu klasimu kandi babara obukuru bwabyo. 3) Nibakora omugani ogurikukwata aha kubara obukuru bw'ekibu, kandi bagarukamu omu sentimita za kwaraada (cm²) nari omu mita za kwaraada (m²), nk'oku kirikwetagisa.

question: Omwegyesereza n’ekibiina ky’abeeshumi ab’omukaaga abari omu mwaka ogw’okutaano abarikwega ekigyendererwa eki: “Kupima obuhingiro n’ebipimo ebirikukoresibwa buriijo n’okushobora amateeka g’okuhindura aha bipimo ebi.” Kutiisya eki, akatebeekanisiza abeeshumi omu bibiina yaabahabura kukora omurimo ogu: 1) Koresa omupiima ogurikwoleka emita n’obusentimita kupima obuhingiro bw’ebintu ebirikushangwa omu kicweka ky’okwegeramu. 2) Handiika ebipimo by’ebintu ebi omu bipimo byombi. 3) Shaba iteeka ry’okuhindura obusentimita kuba emita. Ebicweka bibiri eby’okubanza by’omurimo bikagenda gye. Kwonka, omu kicweka kya kashatu, ebibiina bingi bikahika aha mpero y’okugira ngu okuhindura ekipimo kuruga omu busentimita okukihindura emita, kikaba nikyetenga kwongyera emirundi 100, ahabw’okugira ngu omuta gumwe guine obusentimita 100. Twareeba aha mpero y’abeeshumi, niki aha bintu ebi omwegyesereza araakore ekirikubaasa kubahabura omu kwega kwabo?
answer_a: Mubagambire bagyezaho kutebeekanisa ekiragiro ekirikukora omukukyusa kuruga omuri sentimita kuza omuri mita, nibashwijuma ebyarugiremu omu kupima kwabo kandi nibakora emirimo yabo omu buringaniza.
answer_b: Yorekyeza aha, ekiragiro eki kirikukoresibwa kikyusa ebipimo kuruga omuri meeto kuhika omuri sentimita, tikurikukora kuruga omuri sentimita kuhika omuri meeto. Ninkushaba orungye eky'okugarukamu kyaawe orikukoresa omuringo ogurikugaruramu ogu orikukozesa.
answer_c: Baireke kubanza kukoresa iteeka erikakozirweyo kuhindura obuhingiro bw'ebintu ebyapimwe omuri sentimita kubutwara omuri mita, hanyuma bagyeragyeranise ebyabireho, barabe nibahindura iteeka nk'oku barikureeba.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w'eky'omunaana n'abaana be aha mutwe gw'Algebra, kandi omu bwiire oburikwija, naija kuteeraho ekigyendererwa "Kuhuumurira obutaringaniza omu muringo ogurikukwatwaho, omu bishushani, nari omu bubonero." Kugira ngu akihikiirize, omurimo gw'okubanza nigwija kwesigama aha kumanyisa okw'omuhimbo okwahingwireho kugira ngu atunguure ekigyendererwa eki. Okumanya ki okw'omuhimbo omwegyesa ashemereire kumanyisa omu murimo gw'okubanza?
answer_a: 1) Okuhindura kuruga omu rurimi rwa burijo okuta omu rurimi rw'ebibarizo. 2) Okucweeka enyimaizo ezirikushushana
answer_b: 1) Okukora emirimo erikukuru n'enamba ezirimu obuzima. 2) Okucumura enkwatanisa ezirukukora omurongozi kuraba omu miringo erikushushana
answer_c: 1) Okwetegyereza amakuru g'obubonero >, <, ≥, na ≤. 2) Okushoborora oburinganiza kuraba omu mupimo ogutarikuringaniza.
answer_d: 1) Okureetera omukwanaganyo gw'obutaringaniza omu bishushani. 2) Okushoborora ebirikugarukwamu by'obutaringaniza.

question: Okwegyesa omwegyesa owa 5, abeera naakora aha bigendererwa by'okwegyesa ebi: "Kuzura ekiragiro ekirikushoborora endinganizo ei orikuhairwa kandi ekurikukwasa kwenda ebiraizooba." Ebirikukurataho nibi ebiraayorekye yaaba ekigendererwa eki kyahikiirirwe?
answer_a: Nibarikiriza ebirikwija kubaho kurugiirira aha muteekateeko ogurikwoleka.
answer_b: Nibarikira aha bigambo by'omuhari kuronda omugyenderera oguri hagati yaabyo
answer_c: Nibakora omurongo kurugiirira aha mutindo ogu baheebwa kandi bashohoze obuhame bw'okubaka kwabo.
answer_d: Nibarikiriza omuruuru kandi bagamba oku orikubaasa kutunga ekigambo kuruga omu kirikubanza.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa w’ekyangahe kya mukaaga n’abegyi be aha kucumura emiringo y’omurongo ogw’okubanza ogurikugira ekitarikumanywa kimwe, arikukoresa amagezi agasheeneene. Omu ishomero, omwegyesa naagamba aha magezi g’okucweicweamu n’okuhikaanisa ebirimu byona aha buri rubaju rw’omurongo. Aha mirimo ekurikukurira, niki ekirikworeka ngu abegyi beegyeire kukoresa amagezi aga omu kucumura emiringo?
answer_a:
1) Yolesa omulingo 14 = 6 + x omu muringo ogurikwetegyereza; nk'eky'okureeberaho, okukoresa omunzani ogutari murungi, ogu twine obucube 14 aha rubaju rumwe na 6 aha rundi.
2) Shobora omuhendo gw'ebicube ebirikukwatanisa omunzani oguhingwire.
3) Yolesa eky'okugarukamu omu rurimi rw'eby'okubara: x = 8
answer_b:
1) Obara ki namba ki twongyera ahari 6, tukatunga 14?
2) Shanga namba erikukuratira omuringo ogu: 6 + 8 = 6 + x.
3) Gyeragura eky'okugarukamu omu rurimi rw'ekibalangulo: x = 8
answer_c:
1) Teera ekizibu "Ni namba ki eyongyerwe ahari 6 erikuruga omu 14?" okukoresa omuringo gw'ekikwatane 14 = 6 + x?
2) Kora aha kikwatane eki ohaire, otunge x = 8.
3) Garukamu ekizibu eki.
answer_d:
1) Teera ekizibu "Ku ndikaba ntanziibwe obukalamu 6 kandi hati nyine 14, nkaba nyine obukalamu bwingaha omu kubanza?" okukoresa omuringo gw'ekikwatane 14 = 6 + x.
2) Tangaanira ekikwatane eki kirikugambwa, otunge x = 8.
3) Garukamu ekizibu.

question: Omugyezibwa omu omuhandiizi omu mwaka gwa kabiri omuishomero rya sekenda ari kutebeekaniza ebi akwegyesa arikugyenderera aha mugasho "Kutebeekanisiza namba ezitarikukwata aha mutabo n'okuzishushaniiza aha murongo gw'enamba". Orukurato oruha orurikukurataho rw'emikoreso nirwo rurikutwara abegi omukika kandi bakahikiiriza omugasho ogwo?
answer_a:
1) Shobora ebizibu omu bitebyo by'ekibalangulo ebitarikumara omumaro omu namba ezirikushobora kugarukwamu nk'ekicweka.
2) Shobora kukora omurizi gw'omuzora gw'enamba nkuru, orikwetegyereza omuhendo ogwo otungire.
3) Gereka omu kikumi kimwe omu omurizi ogwo ogwabuzire, orikukozesa obuto n'obwingi.
answer_b:
1) Sharamura omuzi gw'ebitare by'omubazo, otaine kukozesa ekibalangulo.
2) Shanga emizi egiherize aha mukura gw'emibaro, orikurora omuguruko gwagyo.
3) Shanga emizi egiherize aha mukura gw'emibaro, orikukozesa omufuzi n'ekyoma ky'okusharamura.
answer_c:
1) Zombeka ekishushani ky'omuringo gw'orubaju rwa sentimita 1 reero oteekeho omurongo ogurikuruga aha mpisho emwe kuruga omuhanda.
2) Zombeka ekishushani kisya ky'omuringo gw'orubaju aha murongo ogurikuruga aha mpisho emwe kuruga omuhanda gw'ekishushani ekyabandize.
3) Teeka omuhanda gw'okushobora kubara obwinganiza bw'ekishushani kisya ky'omuringo gw'orubaju kandi omuhingure omugatte gwakyo aha murongo gw'emibaro.
answer_d:
1) Sharamura omuzi gw'ebibarangu by'omubazo ebikuru kuraba omuhanda gw'okubara, orikwegerereza omugabo gwagwo.
2) Shungura enshonga z'okucurirana eziri ahagati y'emiziyo eyabandize, orikwetegereza ngu omurimo gw'omuzi gw'ekyanya nigukura.
3) Shanga emiziyo eyabandize aha murongo gw'emibaro, orikukoresa puroguramu y'ebishushani.

question: Omwe aha migingo y'okwegyesa ey'omwaka ogw'okubanza owa secondary n'ogu: "Kukura emiteeko y'obumanzi, omuteeko gw'okwongyera, omuteeko gw'okubaaza, n'okwegatta kwabyombi, omu muringo ogurikushobora, ogw'ebishushani, n'ogw'akabonero, omu mikono nari/oba n'ebikoreso by'obwegyesa, omu mbeera y'okumaraho ebizibu." Omu miringo ei omwegyesa arikutebeekanisa, n'oguhe ogurikushobora abegi kwetegyereza ebiri omunda y'omugingo ogu?
answer_a: Teeka ebizibu ebirimu okubalira obukuru bw'okubaho kw'ekintu
answer_b: Eihuririro n'omukato gw'ebitebe nibimanyisa ki?
answer_c: Shobora omuringo emigarami erikukoresa ebishushani by'omuti erikukuraho emiramu
answer_d: Taataana embeera omukoraanwa gwa buli mugano ogurikukoresibwa n'amateeka.

question: Omugyezibwa omweegi owa secondary omu mwaka ogwa kabiri ari kutebeekaniza ekicweka eki araatandikireho kukurata ekigyendererwa eki: "Kukuza n'okuteebereza omuringo gw'okubara obwinganiza bw'ekintu ekiri nk'omupiira". Murimo ki ogu abegi abaraakore, ogu gubarikubasisa kukora aha kigyendererwa ky'ekicweka, twarikureeba ngu nibamanya ebintu ebi barikweteenga kumanya kuruga omu myaka eyaherire?
answer_a: Yimutsya omusenyu kuruga omu muringo nk'ebihogo okugyiha omu kintu ekirikushushana n'omugongo ogurikwetorora ebihogo, reero ogyenderere aha mugeraniso gw'obwinganiza bwabyo
answer_b: Koresa omusingi gwa Cavalieri aha kooni, silinda, n'enkuru y'omutwe oguringanire, ohabure n'omugano gw'emiramu yabyo.
answer_c: Obungiro obugumire nibwo oburikugyenda nibukyezya, kuraba omu museetwe, ebishushani ebirikushushana n'obucweka bw'ekizingirizi kandi oteekateeke omuringo gw'okubara obwinganiza bw'ekizingirizi.
answer_d: Bala enshuraniso aha muhendo gw'obureezi bw'ekoni na silinda eziine omugyera gumwe kandi oreebe omukago oguriho n'omuringo gw'omupiira.

question: Omugyezibwa omu omuri ক্লাসী ya Third-Year akaba nakorera hamwe n'abanyeshuri aha mukoro gw'okukura omu bwangu (exponential function) kandi omu ক্লাসী erikukuraho naija kukora aha mukoro gw'okugabana (logarithmic function). Kuti kukikora, naija kukora omurimo ogurikwebemberwa omu gw'okuruga aha kigambo ky'ebibarizo f(x) = log10(x), barikwija kutebeera emisingi ya x hamwe n'okugishoma omu mukoro ogu kandi barikwija kushushana ekishushani kyagwo, barikushobora obuhangare bwagwo n'oburaingwa bwayo kuraba omu kusesengura kw'ebibarizo. Ahabw'ekyo, omugyezibwa acwireho kuhwereza aha kusesengura kw'ebibarizo arikukoresa omuringo ogundi ogw'okwegyesa. Twashushana ekigyendererwa eki ky'okwegyesa, omuringo gwahaansi ogurikukorwa omugyezibwa niguhiga okwetegyereza obuhangare n'oburaingwa bw'emikoro y'okugabana?
answer_a: Yoreka embeera ezirikukuratirwa emirimo ya logarimu erikugambwa omu kubarizo, nitushobora, hamwe, obukuru bwazo n'oburaingwa bwazo omu mbeera egi turikureba.
answer_b: Yolesa ebigere by'emigwe ey'ebibarizo bya logarithmic etali emwe, buli gumwe n'omugwe gwaakwo ogwa exponential ogurikugarukira haihi, orikugyenderera aha kuteerera n'obureingwa bw'ogw'okubanza, orikuruga omu gwa kabiri
answer_c: Yoreka omugambo gw'ebigambo bya alijebra gw'emikorere y'emikoro gy'ebipimiso bya logarithemu etari mushushanzi, oragire abegi kutunga obusobozi bwabyo n'obunaku bwabyo, ebiragwirwe omu muringo gw'ebibaro.
answer_d: Yolesa eby'okurugaana by'emigwe egwire ey'emikora ya logarithmic etari emwe, buli gumwe n'eky'ahandiikwa kyagwo ekya algebraic, orikushwijuma, hamwe, enshaaniso n'okushushana ebirikureebwa omu bushoboorozi bwabyo n'obwinganiza.

question: Omwegyesereza omwegyesa omu klasse y'omwaka ogwa kabiri naija kukora aha kigyendererwa ekirikukurataho: "Kwetegyereza emicwe y'ekishushani ky'omurimo gw'omukwato ogurikuruga omu muringo f(x) = ax² + bx + c, a ≠ 0 obwo ebintu byagwo a, b, na c birikuhinduka," akihuriire aha kikuru ekiri omu nteekateeka y'eby'okwegyesa aha kukoresa ICT (Eby'obuhangwa n'obukugu bw'eby'amashanyarazi n'eby'okutambuza amahurire). Ni bintu ki ebirikukurataho ebi abeeshuri baraakora ebirikubaasa kuhikiiriza ekigyendererwa ky'eklassse, twaba nitutwara omu maisho ekikuru eki kirikwoorekwa omu nteekateeka y'eby'okwegyesa?
answer_a: Shwijuma empindahindwa z'omurimo gw'ekyombeko, orikushwijuma empindahinduka zaazo kuraba omu rupapura rw'okubara
answer_b: Yoreka omuranga ogurikworeka emiringo etari emwe y'emigongo (parabolas) omu muringo gw'ebishushani n'omukago gwabyo omu kubara.
answer_c: Koresa programu ya kompyuta ekukozesa emiringa y’eky’omulingo (parabolas) kwolesa enkyukakyuuka z’ebipimiso by’omukoro gw’ekibalangulo ky’omulingo ogw’ahaiguru.
